Content:
# 동서대학교 International College (IC) 유학생 가이드

## 1. 비자(Visa) 연장 절차
동서대학교 IC 유학생들은 비자(D-2) 만료 1개월 전부터 연장을 신청해야 합니다. 
필요한 서류는 다음과 같습니다:
- 재학증명서 (발급처: 학생처 또는 무인발급기)
- 성적증명서
- 외국인등록증 원본 및 사본
- 체류지 입증 서류 (기숙사 거주 확인서 또는 원룸 임대차계약서)
- 수수료 60,000원

## 2. 수강신청 방법
매 학기 시작 전 2월과 8월 셋째 주에 수강신청이 진행됩니다.
수강신청은 '동서대학교 학생포털(Student Portal)'에서 온라인으로 진행되며, 전공 필수 과목을 우선적으로 신청해야 합니다.
유학생은 한국어 필수 교양 과목을 이수해야 졸업이 가능합니다.

--- Chunk 2 ---
Source: data\dummy_ic_guide.txt
Content:
## 3. 기숙사 안내
IC 유학생들은 '글로벌 빌리지(Global Village)' 기숙사에 우선 배정됩니다.
- 통금 시간: 밤 12시 ~ 새벽 5시
- 기숙사 내 취사 금지
- 매월 1회 정기 방역 실시

## 4. 아르바이트(시간제 취업) 규정
유학생(D-2)이 아르바이트를 하려면 반드시 학교의 추천서와 출입국관리사무소의 사전 허가를 받아야 합니다.
- 학부생: 주당 최대 20시간 허용 (한국어 능력 TOPIK 3급 이상인 경우 25시간 허용)
- 사전 허가 없이 불법 취업 시 강제 출국 조치될 수 있습니다.

The field of study evaluations in Lithuanian higher education institutions (HEIs) are based on the following: 
● Procedure for the External Evaluation and Accreditation of Studies, Evaluation Areas and

1.4. 검토 배경  
HEI 개요 
Mykolas Romeris University(MRU) 는 리투아니아 법학 대학의 후신으로 2004 년에 설립된 국립 
대학입니다. 68 개의 학업 프로그램(학사 프로그램 24 개, 석사 프로그램 43 개, 전문 학업 프로그램 
1 개)을 제공하며, 주로(95%) 사회 과학, 주로 법학, 심리학, 경제학, 문헌학, 교육학 및 경영학을 
전공합니다. MRU 는 ERUA 연합(European Alliance of Reform Universities)의 일부입니다.

V. 요약 
 
MRU 의 "게임 개발 및 디지털 애니메이션" 프로그램은 여러 면에서 특이합니다.

Dongseo’s International College offers English-based education in the fields of Global Business Administration, Korean Language and Business, Computer Science, Game Development, Animation, Film and Visua Effects and Digital Design, and Liberal Education with Korean and English Language & Culture Programs. International students who are not proficient in Korean can thus increase their global potential by earning an undergraduate degree abroad at DSU in one of the university's specialized fields.

Game Database Programmer
 
This concentration includes the essential courses required for developing game databases. Through this program, students aim to acquire the programming ability to apply technical methods for building game databases and to integrate game servers with games in order to solve given problems.

Game Server Programming

--- Chunk 1756 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Content:
Content:
The Lithuanian Ministry of Education officially approved a 2+2 Joint Degree Program between Dongseo University (DSU) and Mykolas Romeris University (MRU) in the field of Informatics and Digital Contents. It was launched in September of 2014. Students admitted to the joint degree program take fundamental courses in their major along with Korean language courses at MRU for the first two years of the program. Then they complete the remaining two years of the program at DSU.

--- Chunk 1758 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Petra Christian University (PCU) is a major private Christian university in Surabaya, Indonesia, established in 1961. PCU and DSU launched a 2+2 Joint Degree Program in November of 2014. Degrees from both universities will be awarded to students who complete two years of study at PCU and two years of study at DSU in the field of digital contents.

Career Tracks
There are two main types of programmers in game development: client developers and server developers. This 2+2 program offers a specialized curriculum designed for both of these roles.

--- Chunk 1768 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Game Client Developer
In 3rd year, students learn 2D/3D graphics knowledge and various design patterns used in commercial games and start to develop games with a game engine. In 4th year, students are doing graduation projects and prepare stuff for a portfolio.

Graduation Requirement
Everything you need to know to successfully complete your Graduation Project or Research Thesis and meet all requirements for graduation from the Computer Science program.

Requirement Type
Project or Thesis
Graduation Project or Research Thesis — choose one

Max Team Size
3
Individual or team project — up to 3 students per team

Grade C

--- Chunk 1932 ---

Content:
Graduation Project
Build and submit a working system — software, hardware, or a combination of both — and document it as a written thesis.
Examples
Web / mobile application  ·  AI-based system  ·  IoT device  ·  Cloud service  ·  Game  ·  Embedded system

Research Thesis
Investigate an existing topic in computer science, conduct your research, and write up your findings as a formal academic thesis.
Examples
AI / ML algorithm study  ·  Security analysis  ·  Performance comparison  ·  Software architecture review

Work Individually or Form a Team

Result
Pass (Grade C or above from all judges) and you are cleared for graduation. Fail and you may re-present during a separately announced re-evaluation period.

Judging Committee
2+ Professors

Passing Grade
Grade C

Criteria Set By
Curriculum Committee
Evaluation criteria are set by the major curriculum committee each semester.

Dongseo’s International College offers English-based education in the fields of Global Business Administration, Korean Language and Business, Computer Science, Game Development, Animation, Film and Visua Effects and Digital Design, and Liberal Education with Korean and English Language & Culture Programs. International students who are not proficient in Korean can thus increase their global potential by earning an undergraduate degree abroad at DSU in one of the university's specialized fields.

Micro Degree (MD)
✦ Career Path Program
A Micro Degree (MD) is your Career Path — specialized credentials earned alongside your bachelor's degree. Each track focuses intensely on a single, professionally applicable subject to sharpen your expertise and strengthen your career profile.

4 Specialized Tracks
Industry-Aligned Curriculum
Extracurricular Recognition
Career-Ready Skills

--- Chunk 2411 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Content:
What Is a Micro Degree?
Unlike a traditional degree that covers a broad range of topics, a Micro Degree (MD) is an intensive, focused program in a single, professionally applicable subject. By completing specific required courses and extracurricular activities, students earn a recognized credential that demonstrates specialized expertise to future employers.

MD 01 - Cloud Solution Architecture
Cloud Solution Architecture
Designed for students who want to architect technology solutions for organizations adopting cloud computing. This track equips you with the critical skills needed to implement, manage, and migrate cloud initiatives in real-world environments.

--- Chunk 2600 ---

Content:
Content:
Content:
The Lithuanian Ministry of Education officially approved a 2+2 Joint Degree Program between Dongseo University (DSU) and Mykolas Romeris University (MRU) in the field of Informatics and Digital Contents. It was launched in September of 2014. Students admitted to the joint degree program take fundamental courses in their major along with Korean language courses at MRU for the first two years of the program. Then they complete the remaining two years of the program at DSU.

Petra Christian University (PCU) is a major private Christian university in Surabaya, Indonesia, established in 1961. PCU and DSU launched a 2+2 Joint Degree Program in November of 2014. Degrees from both universities will be awarded to students who complete two years of study at PCU and two years of study at DSU in the field of digital contents.

What Is a Micro Degree?
Unlike a traditional degree that covers a broad range of topics, a Micro Degree (MD) is an intensive, focused program in a single, professionally applicable subject. By completing specific required courses and extracurricular activities, students earn a recognized credential that demonstrates specialized expertise to future employers.

U-Start Programme | Asia Pacific University (APU)

--- Chunk 2225 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Intakes: March / September

ENTRY REQUIREMENTS

5 Credits in at least 5 subjects at SPM level with a minimum of a pass in Bahasa Malaysia and Sejarah (History)

5 Credits (Grade C & above) in at least 5 subjects at IGCSE/ O-Levels

ENGLISH REQUIREMENTS

MALAYSIAN & INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS

Min. IELTS 5.5.

--- Chunk 2787 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 2226 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
U-Start Programme is a special credit-transfer programme between Asia Pacific University (APU) and Dongseo University (DSU) which allows the students of DSU to study their 1st year in APU through credit-transfer courses in APU Foundation Programme in Malaysia before going to Korea to complete the rest of 3 years at DSU. Students need to be registered at DSU. All fees are payable to DSU in Korea for Year 1.

Content:
DSU is one of the leading universities in Busan, South Korea. The Dongseo Educational Foundation has given rise to three different institutions of higher education: Kyungnam College of Information and Technology (1965), Dongseo University (1992), and Busan Digital University (2002). Together these three institutions – KIT, DSU and BDU– educate around 20,000 students annually and employ over 1,000 professors.

2026년 「지역특화형 비자 사업(지역특화형 우수인재)」 모집부산광역시는 우수한 외국인 인재 유치 및 정착을 위한 지역특화형 비자 사업을 실시하고 있습니다.이번 모집에 우수한 외국인 인재 여러분의 많은 관심과 참여 바랍니다.○ (모집유형) 지역특화형 우수인재(F-2-R)○ (모집인원) 105명(동구 32, 서구 30, 영도구 43) * 특정국가 30% 제한<구별 지역우수인재 모집인원>구 분합 계동 구서 구영도구비 고배정인원150505050 기 추천인원4518207 모집인원105323043 (베트남)(12)(3)(모집 종료)(9) ※ 모집인원 초과 접수 시 기본소양, 세부유형, 신청유형, 부산시 거주기간 점수를 합산하여 고득점 순 선발, 동점인 경우 ’부산시 거주기간-연령(연소자 순)-접수순서‘ 순으로 최종 선발○ (모집기간) ‘26. 3. 30.(월) 09:00 ~ 4. 17.(금) 18:00○ (접 수 처) 동구·서구·영도구청 지역특화형 비자 담당부서- 동구청 총무과(부산 동구

In the Motion Graphics Design track, you’ll explore how movement, timing, and visual storytelling create powerful digital narratives. You’ll develop advanced skills in animation, compositing, and time-based media production using industry-standard creative tools, while experimenting with interactive and real-time visual systems. Through studio projects, you’ll learn how motion graphics shape communication across advertising, digital displays, entertainment media, and immersive environments.

Game Server Programming
A game server is a server which is the authoritative source of events in a multiplayer video game. The server transmits enough data about its internal state to allow its connected clients to maintain their own accurate version of the game world for display to players. They also receive and process each player's input. Students learn all techniques used in the game server.

• Purpose
GP101 Lab is a research group dedicated to exploring and advancing the art and science of game development using Unity. Our primary goal is to cultivate student creativity, technical proficiency, and collaborative skills by designing, prototyping, and developing original games. We aim to bridge academic learning with real-world application through hands-on projects, workshops, and industry engagement.

--- Chunk 2767 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
This program is a tutoring program in which Dongseo University Korean students help foreign students learn the Korean language and get to know Korean culture, and in return foreign students can help Korean students understand their language and learn their culture. During the semester, the program runs for a total of 5 to 10 weeks, 1:1 matching Korean and foreign students work together.

Content:
본 프로그램은 동서대 재학생들과 외국인 학생들이 자국의 언어와 문화를 알려주며 소통하는 튜터링 프로그램으로 2020년 여름, 파일럿 프로그램으로 처음 시작하여 매년 2회차로 꾸준히 운영 중입니다. 학기 중 5주간 운영되며 1:1로 매칭된 한국인튜터-외국인튜티가 함께 활동합니다. 참여 학생들은 다양한 외국어(영어, 중국어, 일본어 등)를 매개로 하여 온/오프라인으로 만나 1주 1회 이상 튜터링을 진행하며, 서로의 언어와 문화를 교류하면서 외국어 실력을 키우게 됩니다.

지난 2021년에는 총 441명(한국인 학생 226명, 외국인 학생 215명), 2022년에는 총 174명(한국인 87명, 외국인 87명)이 본 프로그램에 참여했습니다. 동서대학교에 재학 중인 외국인학생들과는 대면 중심의 활동을 하며, 국외 대학 및 세종학당의 학생들과는 비대면(zoom 등 활용)으로 활동을 합니다. 인도네시아 PCU 수라바야세종학당, 리투아니아 MRU 빌뉴스세종학당, 러시아 ASU 아스트라한세종학당, 미국 세인트메리대학의 샌안토니오세종학당, 중국 광동외어외무대학, 일본 리츠메이칸대학의 학생들이 그동안 함께 했습니다.

[2026 Sasang-gu Health Check-up Support Program for International Students]*This is a notice from the Sasang-gu Office.Sasang-gu is pleased to announce a health check-up support program to promote the well-being and stable settlement of international students residing in our district.1. Application Period: March 16 ~ October 31, 2026 (until the budget is exhausted.)2. Eligibility: International students (D-2, D-4 visa holders) who have reported their place of residence as Sasang-gu as of the

7. 함께하는 튜티(외국인학생)의 구성은 어떻게 되나요? 

답변

--- Chunk 3157 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 2365 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000258

--- Chunk 3911 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
매칭되는 튜티는 크게 오프라인으로 만날 수 있는 교내 외국인학생과 온라인으로 만날 수 있는 해외 외국인학생으로 나뉩니다. 1. 교내 외국인학생동서대학교 International College 소속 외국인 학생이 가장 다수입니다. 베트남, 우즈베키스탄, 인도네시아, 리투아니아, 인도 등 10여개국에서 온 많은 외국인 학생들이 우리 학교에서 유학 중입니다. 모국어가 영어는 아니지만 영어로 전공과정을 이수 중인 영어트랙 학생들인 만큼 영어로 유창하게 소통이 가능합니다. 이 외에 중국의 여러 협정대학 학생들이 다수 있으며, 일본, 태국 등 초청 및 교환학생들도 본 프로그램에서 만날 수 있습니다. 이 경우 중국어, 일본어, 태국어 등 각자 모국어로 소통하게 됩니다.  그리고 동서대학교 외국어교육원에서 한국어 어학연수 중인 외국인학생들이 참여하는 회차도 있습니다.  2. 해외 외국인학생동서대학교는 해외 각지의 세종학당과 협력하고 있습니다. 인도네시아 수라바야 세종학당, 러시아 아스트라한

각지의 세종학당과 협력하고 있습니다. 인도네시아 수라바야 세종학당, 러시아 아스트라한 세종학당, 리투아니아 빌뉴스 세종학당의 학생들과 작년 한 해 꾸준히 Go, Global! 활동을 함께했습니다. 모두 온라인으로 만나며 보통 zoom을 활용합니다. 한국어를 배우고 있는 학생들이라서 한국어로 대부분 소통이 가능한 경우도 있고, 초급 수준인 경우 영어로 소통합니다. 시차가 있어 서로 배려하며 만나는 시간을 조정해야 하는 특징이 있고, 고등학생이나 직장인 학생이 매칭되기도 합니다. 프로그램을 지원할 때 참고해 주세요! ^^

6. 학습포인트(튜터 3점, 튜티 1점)는 일괄 지급되나요?  

답변

- 아닙니다. 튜터링 활동을 성실하게 했는지를 확인한 후 그 결과에 따라 차등 지급합니다.따라서 주어진 활동을 다 하지 못한 경우 학습포인트가 차감될 수 있습니다.

질문

5. 규칙적으로 활동하지 않고 일정 기간에 몰아서 활동을 해도 되나요?  

답변

- 아닙니다. 1주에 1회를 기본으로 합니다. 불가피한 경우 한 주에 2회까지는 가능하지만 그 이상 몰아서 한꺼번에 활동을 하는 것은 인정되지 않습니다.

질문

4. 카카오톡이나 DM을 주고받는 것만으로도 튜터링 활동으로 인정되나요? 

답변

--- Chunk 3914 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
4. 카카오톡이나 DM을 주고받는 것만으로도 튜터링 활동으로 인정되나요? 

답변

- 아닙니다. 튜터링 활동은 원래 대면 활동이 기본입니다. 불가피한 상황이 아니라면 이 규칙을 지켜주세요.

질문

답변

--- Chunk 3915 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
3. 활동기록표 제출은 언제, 어떻게 해야 하나요?

답변

활동기록표는 활동이 완료 된 후 담당자 이메일를 통해 제출합니다.* 홈페이지에서 파일을 다운로드 한 후, 한 활동을 정리하여 제출하면 됩니다.* 만약 제출 기간이 되었는데 부분적으로 진행된 상황이라면 그때까지 했던 활동만 정리해서 정해진 기간 내에 제출하도록 하세요.

질문

2. 튜티링 활동 1회의 활동 시간 기준은 어떻게 되나요? 

답변

- 학기 중에는 1주에 1시간 활동하는 것을 권장합니다. (기준 : 5주 동안 총 5시간 이상)

질문

1.튜티링 활동은 총 몇 회 해야 하나요? 

답변

--- Chunk 3162 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
질문

1.튜티링 활동은 총 몇 회 해야 하나요? 

답변

- 튜터링 활동은 총 5주에 걸쳐 진행됩니다.그 기간 안에 총 5회를 마무리하면 됩니다.예시) 1주에 1회(1시간)

 What is a U-START Programme?

--- Chunk 3465 ---

Overview
 What is a U-START Programme?

--- Chunk 4287 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
U-Start Programme is a special credit-transfer programme between Asia Pacific University(APU) and Dongseo University (DSU) which allows the students of DSU to study their 1st year in APU through credit-transfer courses in APU Foundation Programme in Malaysia before going to Korea to complete the rest of 3 years at DSU. Students need to be registered at DSU.

Career Paths
Our graduates pursue diverse career opportunities in the technology industry, from software development and AI engineering to entrepreneurship and advanced academic research. Our comprehensive education system, combining curricular and co-curricular programs, prepares students for three main career pathways: industry employment (including regional settlement), return to home country for career opportunities, and graduate school advancement.

The ICT Convergence and Security Lab (ICSLab), is jointly led by Prof. YoungSil Lee and Prof. Jintaek Seo. ICSLab strives to build the capabilities to conduct various research areas in computer engineering and science that go beyond software development (from making a simple website to games). The students will take part in multidisciplinary research and have the opportunity to interact with industry experts through various research activities, such as visiting exhibitions, participating in

Korean Language & BusinessA specialized program for international students, cultivating global talent equipped with Korean language communication skills and business expertise. We develop the next generation of leaders who will drive Asian business with a deep understanding of Korean culture and management knowledge.

About Korean Language & BusinessAs Korea's global influence continues to expand, interest in the Korean language and culture is growing worldwide. The KLB (Korean Language & Business) department is a specialized program designed for international students to intensively study Korean language, Korean culture, and business.Our department focuses on three core competencies: Korean language communication as a foreign language, Korean cultural content literacy, and business practical skills. We

Curriculum by Track
Korean TrackIn the 1st and 2nd years, students build global competencies through intensive Korean and English courses. In the 3rd and 4th years, they strengthen practical skills through a business-centered curriculum.

Content:
English TrackIn the 1st year, students establish their language foundation through intensive Korean courses within the liberal arts education program. From the 2nd to 4th years, they strengthen practical skills through a curriculum focused on Korean language and business. Korean-related courses are conducted in Korean, while business-related courses are taught in English, allowing students to develop expertise in a bilingual environment.

Content:
Graduation Requirements
To graduate, students must complete at least 120 credits (including a minimum of 60 major credits, 30 general education credits (including 12 required credits), and 30 elective credits), pass the comprehensive graduation exam, and obtain at least Level 4 on the Test of Proficiency in Korean (TOPIK).

Graduation Requirement

Requirement Type
Project or Thesis

3

--- Chunk 5253 ---

Content:
Graduation Project
Build and submit a working system — software, hardware, or a combination of both — and document it as a written thesis.
Examples
Web / mobile application  ·  AI-based system  ·  IoT device  ·  Cloud service  ·  Game  ·  Embedded system

Research Thesis
Investigate an existing topic in computer science, conduct your research, and write up your findings as a formal academic thesis.
Examples
AI / ML algorithm study  ·  Security analysis  ·  Performance comparison  ·  Software architecture review

Work Individually or Form a Team
You may work individually or form a team of up to 3 students. Submit your project or thesis proposal by the announced deadline, under your advisory professor's guidance.

Develop the Project / Conduct Research

Final Presentation and Submission

Result
Pass (Grade C or above from all judges) and you are cleared for graduation. Fail and you may re-present during a separately announced re-evaluation period.

2025년도 한국어 TOPIK 시험 대비를 위한 TOPIK 특강이 진행됩니다.이번 특강은 TOPIK 10월 18일에 실시하는 공인 TOPIK 시험 직전 대비반으로학생 여러분의 시험 등급 향상에 큰 도움이 될 것입니다.프로그램명: 2025 TOPIK 특강(1차)프로그램 기간: 10월 15일(수), 17일(금)일정: 13:00~15:00(2시간) 특강 2일(총 4시간)수강인원: 20명(선착순)강의실: International College 603호신청링크: https://forms.gle/w5ZB9BNjL74CZJNm6강의는 대면 강의(오프라인 강의)로 진행됩니다. 온라인 강의가 아닙니다.응답을 제출한 이메일로 선정 여부를 알려드립니다.이메일을 잘 확인해주세요.특강과 관련하여 문의가 있다면 아래의 연락처로 문의 주시길 바랍니다.이메일: dsu.rise.global@gmail.com문의처: 뉴밀레니엄관 8층 라이즈사업단 유준욱

Industry-academia cooperation Project
The industry-academia project refers to a formalization process within the undergraduate department or a project through industry-academia cooperation. Industry-academia projects focus on what is as consistent with the undergraduate structure as possible, and should also be clear about the benefits and use of final results for students who participated in the project.

Content:
What Is a Micro Degree?
Unlike a traditional degree that covers a broad range of topics, a Micro Degree (MD) is an intensive, focused program in a single, professionally applicable subject. By completing specific required courses and extracurricular activities, students earn a recognized credential that demonstrates specialized expertise to future employers.

--- Chunk 5903 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Content:
Content:
The Lithuanian Ministry of Education officially approved a 2+2 Joint Degree Program between Dongseo University (DSU) and Mykolas Romeris University (MRU) in the field of Informatics and Digital Contents. It was launched in September of 2014. Students admitted to the joint degree program take fundamental courses in their major along with Korean language courses at MRU for the first two years of the program. Then they complete the remaining two years of the program at DSU.

--- Chunk 5905 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Petra Christian University (PCU) is a major private Christian university in Surabaya, Indonesia, established in 1961. PCU and DSU launched a 2+2 Joint Degree Program in November of 2014. Degrees from both universities will be awarded to students who complete two years of study at PCU and two years of study at DSU in the field of digital contents.

Micro Degree (MD)
✦ Career Path Program
A Micro Degree (MD) is your Career Path — specialized credentials earned alongside your bachelor's degree. Each track focuses intensely on a single, professionally applicable subject to sharpen your expertise and strengthen your career profile.

What Is a Micro Degree?

--- Chunk 5933 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt

Content:
What Is a Micro Degree?
Unlike a traditional degree that covers a broad range of topics, a Micro Degree (MD) is an intensive, focused program in a single, professionally applicable subject. By completing specific required courses and extracurricular activities, students earn a recognized credential that demonstrates specialized expertise to future employers.

2025년도 한국어 TOPIK 시험 대비를 위한 TOPIK 특강이 진행됩니다.이번 특강은 TOPIK 10월 18일, 11월 16일에 실시하는 공인 TOPIK 시험 직전 대비반으로학생 여러분의 시험 등급 향상에 큰 도움이 될 것입니다.10월, 11월에 있을 시험 일정에 맞춰 2회 진행될 계획입니다.10월(1차)에 수강하지 못하는 학생들은 11월(2차) 강의를 꼭! 신청해주세요.학생 여러분들의 많은 관심과 참여 바랍니다.프로그램명: 2025 TOPIK 특강(1차)프로그램 기간: 10월 셋째주(13~17 중)일정: 주중 2시간 특강 2일(총 4시간) (정확한 시간은 미정)강의는 대면 강의(오프라인 강의)로 진행됩니다. 온라인 강의가 아닙니다.프로그램 신청은 추후 안내될 예정입니다.게시판을 잘 확인해 주세요.특강과 관련하여 문의가 있다면 아래의 연락처로 문의주시길 바랍니다.이메일: dsu.rise.global@gmail.com문의처: 뉴밀레니엄관 8층 라이즈사업단 유준욱The 2025

U-Start Programme | Asia Pacific University (APU)

Intakes: March / September

ENTRY REQUIREMENTS

--- Chunk 4939 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Intakes: March / September

ENTRY REQUIREMENTS

5 Credits in at least 5 subjects at SPM level with a minimum of a pass in Bahasa Malaysia and Sejarah (History)

5 Credits (Grade C & above) in at least 5 subjects at IGCSE/ O-Levels

--- Chunk 6059 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 4940 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
U-Start Programme is a special credit-transfer programme between Asia Pacific University (APU) and Dongseo University (DSU) which allows the students of DSU to study their 1st year in APU through credit-transfer courses in APU Foundation Programme in Malaysia before going to Korea to complete the rest of 3 years at DSU. Students need to be registered at DSU. All fees are payable to DSU in Korea for Year 1.

Content:
DSU is one of the leading universities in Busan, South Korea. The Dongseo Educational Foundation has given rise to three different institutions of higher education: Kyungnam College of Information and Technology (1965), Dongseo University (1992), and Busan Digital University (2002). Together these three institutions – KIT, DSU and BDU– educate around 20,000 students annually and employ over 1,000 professors.

In the Motion Graphics Design track, you’ll explore how movement, timing, and visual storytelling create powerful digital narratives. You’ll develop advanced skills in animation, compositing, and time-based media production using industry-standard creative tools, while experimenting with interactive and real-time visual systems. Through studio projects, you’ll learn how motion graphics shape communication across advertising, digital displays, entertainment media, and immersive environments.

Content:
• Purpose
GP101 Lab is a research group dedicated to exploring and advancing the art and science of game development using Unity. Our primary goal is to cultivate student creativity, technical proficiency, and collaborative skills by designing, prototyping, and developing original games. We aim to bridge academic learning with real-world application through hands-on projects, workshops, and industry engagement.

--- Chunk 6703 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 5473 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
This program is a tutoring program in which Dongseo University Korean students help foreign students learn the Korean language and get to know Korean culture, and in return foreign students can help Korean students understand their language and learn their culture. During the semester, the program runs for a total of 5 to 10 weeks, 1:1 matching Korean and foreign students work together.

--- Chunk 6706 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
A total of 441 students (226 Korean students, 215 foreign students) participated in this program in 2021, and a total of 174 students (87 Korean students, 87 foreign students) participated in this program in 2022. We engage in face-to-face activities with foreign students enrolled in Dongseo University, and engage in non-face-to-face activities (using zoom, etc.) with students at overseas universities and King Sejong Institute. Students from PCU Surabaya King Sejong Institute in Indonesia, MRU

--- Chunk 6708 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt

--- Chunk 5477 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt

--- Chunk 4187 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000254
Content:
본 프로그램은 동서대 재학생들과 외국인 학생들이 자국의 언어와 문화를 알려주며 소통하는 튜터링 프로그램으로 2020년 여름, 파일럿 프로그램으로 처음 시작하여 매년 2회차로 꾸준히 운영 중입니다. 학기 중 5주간 운영되며 1:1로 매칭된 한국인튜터-외국인튜티가 함께 활동합니다. 참여 학생들은 다양한 외국어(영어, 중국어, 일본어 등)를 매개로 하여 온/오프라인으로 만나 1주 1회 이상 튜터링을 진행하며, 서로의 언어와 문화를 교류하면서 외국어 실력을 키우게 됩니다.

--- Chunk 6709 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 5478 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 4188 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000254
Content:
지난 2021년에는 총 441명(한국인 학생 226명, 외국인 학생 215명), 2022년에는 총 174명(한국인 87명, 외국인 87명)이 본 프로그램에 참여했습니다. 동서대학교에 재학 중인 외국인학생들과는 대면 중심의 활동을 하며, 국외 대학 및 세종학당의 학생들과는 비대면(zoom 등 활용)으로 활동을 합니다. 인도네시아 PCU 수라바야세종학당, 리투아니아 MRU 빌뉴스세종학당, 러시아 ASU 아스트라한세종학당, 미국 세인트메리대학의 샌안토니오세종학당, 중국 광동외어외무대학, 일본 리츠메이칸대학의 학생들이 그동안 함께 했습니다.

Graduation Requirement
Everything you need to know to successfully graduate from the Global Business Administration program.

Requirement Type
Exam
Graduation Comprehensive Examination must be taken

Minimum Pass Grade
Grade C
Grade C (70–79 pts) or above — all judges must agree

English Requirement
At Admission
Score submitted on entry remains valid throughout enrollment

7. 함께하는 튜티(외국인학생)의 구성은 어떻게 되나요? 

답변

Content:
매칭되는 튜티는 크게 오프라인으로 만날 수 있는 교내 외국인학생과 온라인으로 만날 수 있는 해외 외국인학생으로 나뉩니다. 1. 교내 외국인학생동서대학교 International College 소속 외국인 학생이 가장 다수입니다. 베트남, 우즈베키스탄, 인도네시아, 리투아니아, 인도 등 10여개국에서 온 많은 외국인 학생들이 우리 학교에서 유학 중입니다. 모국어가 영어는 아니지만 영어로 전공과정을 이수 중인 영어트랙 학생들인 만큼 영어로 유창하게 소통이 가능합니다. 이 외에 중국의 여러 협정대학 학생들이 다수 있으며, 일본, 태국 등 초청 및 교환학생들도 본 프로그램에서 만날 수 있습니다. 이 경우 중국어, 일본어, 태국어 등 각자 모국어로 소통하게 됩니다.  그리고 동서대학교 외국어교육원에서 한국어 어학연수 중인 외국인학생들이 참여하는 회차도 있습니다.  2. 해외 외국인학생동서대학교는 해외 각지의 세종학당과 협력하고 있습니다. 인도네시아 수라바야 세종학당, 러시아 아스트라한

6. 학습포인트(튜터 3점, 튜티 1점)는 일괄 지급되나요?  

답변

- 아닙니다. 튜터링 활동을 성실하게 했는지를 확인한 후 그 결과에 따라 차등 지급합니다.따라서 주어진 활동을 다 하지 못한 경우 학습포인트가 차감될 수 있습니다.

질문

5. 규칙적으로 활동하지 않고 일정 기간에 몰아서 활동을 해도 되나요?  

답변

- 아닙니다. 1주에 1회를 기본으로 합니다. 불가피한 경우 한 주에 2회까지는 가능하지만 그 이상 몰아서 한꺼번에 활동을 하는 것은 인정되지 않습니다.

질문

4. 카카오톡이나 DM을 주고받는 것만으로도 튜터링 활동으로 인정되나요? 

답변

--- Chunk 7142 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
4. 카카오톡이나 DM을 주고받는 것만으로도 튜터링 활동으로 인정되나요? 

답변

- 아닙니다. 튜터링 활동은 원래 대면 활동이 기본입니다. 불가피한 상황이 아니라면 이 규칙을 지켜주세요.

--- Chunk 7143 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
3. 활동기록표 제출은 언제, 어떻게 해야 하나요?

답변

활동기록표는 활동이 완료 된 후 담당자 이메일를 통해 제출합니다.* 홈페이지에서 파일을 다운로드 한 후, 한 활동을 정리하여 제출하면 됩니다.* 만약 제출 기간이 되었는데 부분적으로 진행된 상황이라면 그때까지 했던 활동만 정리해서 정해진 기간 내에 제출하도록 하세요.

질문

2. 튜티링 활동 1회의 활동 시간 기준은 어떻게 되나요? 

답변

- 학기 중에는 1주에 1시간 활동하는 것을 권장합니다. (기준 : 5주 동안 총 5시간 이상)

질문

1.튜티링 활동은 총 몇 회 해야 하나요? 

답변

Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
질문

1.튜티링 활동은 총 몇 회 해야 하나요? 

답변

- 튜터링 활동은 총 5주에 걸쳐 진행됩니다.그 기간 안에 총 5회를 마무리하면 됩니다.예시) 1주에 1회(1시간)

Overview
 What is a U-START Programme?

--- Chunk 6146 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Overview
 What is a U-START Programme?

--- Chunk 7526 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
U-Start Programme is a special credit-transfer programme between Asia Pacific University(APU) and Dongseo University (DSU) which allows the students of DSU to study their 1st year in APU through credit-transfer courses in APU Foundation Programme in Malaysia before going to Korea to complete the rest of 3 years at DSU. Students need to be registered at DSU.

Graduation Requirement
 
Graduation Requirements
Students in the Digital Design program must complete the following requirements in order to graduate.

--- Chunk 7545 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Completion of 120 total credits
Successful completion of 60 credits of major courses
Submission of a Graduation Portfolio
Participation in the Digital Design Graduation Exhibition

--- Chunk 7546 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 6162 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt

Content:
Graduation Portfolio
Students are expected to include a selection of projects demonstrating their creative and technical abilities across different areas of digital design.
The portfolio may include:
Web Design Project Responsive website or web interface design
Motion Graphics Project Minimum 20 seconds animation or motion design

--- Chunk 7547 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt

Mobile App / UI Design Mobile interface or UX case study

Editorial / Digital Publishing Design Magazine, digital publication, or layout design
Design Research Paper A short research paper or concept development study that explores design ideas, references, and creative process.

Graduation Exhibition
In their final year, students present their projects in the Digital Design Graduation Exhibition, showcasing their work to faculty members, peers, and invited guests. The exhibition highlights students’ creative development and the diverse range of projects produced within the Digital Design program.

[Re-entry Permit: Students who will return home during vacation]If you return home during vacation and come back to Korea, you should get Re-entry Permit before you leave.It takes four working days to get it approved. Please don't forget to apply for re-entry permit at least one week before you leave.After approval, you can print out the approval confirmation document. You should bring it with you when you leave.You should do it online at the hikorea website

Content:
- The purpose of this program is to develop proficiency in Korean language communication across all four language skills: speaking, listening, reading, and writing. The program includes courses on Korean culture and business Korean, taking into account various Korean language usage environments and genres such as pronunciation, grammar, rhetoric, and composition. Through this program, students will gain knowledge and skills in Korean language communication to achieve their goals.

About Computer Science
Computer Science is constantly evolving, and it is an exciting time to be part of this dynamic, rapidly growing field. The International College Computer Science major aims to nurture highly qualified professionals equipped with the creative, hands-on skills necessary to lead the knowledge and information industry of the 21st century, including software development, AI, and cloud computing.

Career Paths
Our graduates pursue diverse career opportunities in the technology industry, from software development and AI engineering to entrepreneurship and advanced academic research. Our comprehensive education system, combining curricular and co-curricular programs, prepares students for three main career pathways: industry employment (including regional settlement), return to home country for career opportunities, and graduate school advancement.

Welcome to Dongseo University, a premier institution at the forefront of the Film and Visual Effects industry in Korea. In our Film and Visual Effects major at the International College, we are dedicated to cultivating the next generation of visionary artists and technical experts. Our curriculum bridges theoretical foundations with practical expertise, preparing students to become influential creators in a sector that shapes our cultural and media landscapes.

--- Chunk 8096 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
2025년도 한국어 TOPIK 시험 대비를 위한 TOPIK 특강이 진행됩니다.이번 특강은 TOPIK 11월 16일에 실시하는 공인 TOPIK 시험 직전 대비반으로학생 여러분의 시험 등급 향상에 큰 도움이 될 것입니다.프로그램명: 2025 TOPIK 특강(2차)프로그램 기간: 11월 12일(수), 14일(금)일정: 13:00~15:00(2시간) 특강 2일(총 4시간)수강인원: 20명(선착순)강의실: International College 605호신청링크: https://forms.gle/uPUBSCzHJQ2YpcHi9강의는 대면 강의(오프라인 강의)로 진행됩니다. 온라인 강의가 아닙니다.응답을 제출한 이메일로 선정 여부를 알려드립니다.이메일을 잘 확인해주세요.특강과 관련하여 문의가 있다면 아래의 연락처로 문의 주시길 바랍니다.이메일: dsu.rise.global@gmail.com문의처: 뉴밀레니엄관 8층 라이즈사업단 유준욱

Graduation Requirement
Everything you need to know to successfully complete your Graduation Project or Research Thesis and meet all requirements for graduation from the Computer Science program.

Requirement Type
Project or Thesis
Graduation Project or Research Thesis — choose one

Max Team Size
3
Individual or team project — up to 3 students per team

Grade C

--- Chunk 8496 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Graduation Project
Build and submit a working system — software, hardware, or a combination of both — and document it as a written thesis.
Examples
Web / mobile application  ·  AI-based system  ·  IoT device  ·  Cloud service  ·  Game  ·  Embedded system

Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt

Content:
Research Thesis
Investigate an existing topic in computer science, conduct your research, and write up your findings as a formal academic thesis.
Examples
AI / ML algorithm study  ·  Security analysis  ·  Performance comparison  ·  Software architecture review

2
How It Works — Process & Timeline

How It Works — Process & Timeline

Work Individually or Form a Team
You may work individually or form a team of up to 3 students. Submit your project or thesis proposal by the announced deadline, under your advisory professor's guidance.

Final Presentation and Submission

--- Chunk 6950 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Result
Pass (Grade C or above from all judges) and you are cleared for graduation. Fail and you may re-present during a separately announced re-evaluation period.

3
Evaluation Criteria

--- Chunk 8501 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Judging Committee
2+ Professors
Two or more faculty members serve as judges. The advisory professor may also be included.

--- Chunk 6951 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Passing Grade
Grade C
All judges must individually award Grade C (70–79 pts) or above. A single judge below C means a fail.

Criteria Set By
Curriculum Committee
Evaluation criteria are set by the major curriculum committee each semester.

About

About
 

At Dongseo University’s Graduate School, International College manages three majors:
- Dept of Business Administration offering MA and PH.D degrees taught in English

- Dept of Visual Contents with Animation, Film and VFX tracks offering MA, MFA, and PH.D degrees taught in English

--- Chunk 8544 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
2025년도 한국어 TOPIK 시험 대비를 위한 TOPIK 특강이 진행됩니다.이번 특강은 TOPIK 10월 18일에 실시하는 공인 TOPIK 시험 직전 대비반으로학생 여러분의 시험 등급 향상에 큰 도움이 될 것입니다.프로그램명: 2025 TOPIK 특강(1차)프로그램 기간: 10월 15일(수), 17일(금)일정: 13:00~15:00(2시간) 특강 2일(총 4시간)수강인원: 20명(선착순)강의실: International College 603호신청링크: https://forms.gle/w5ZB9BNjL74CZJNm6강의는 대면 강의(오프라인 강의)로 진행됩니다. 온라인 강의가 아닙니다.응답을 제출한 이메일로 선정 여부를 알려드립니다.이메일을 잘 확인해주세요.특강과 관련하여 문의가 있다면 아래의 연락처로 문의 주시길 바랍니다.이메일: dsu.rise.global@gmail.com문의처: 뉴밀레니엄관 8층 라이즈사업단 유준욱

✦ Career Path Program
A Micro Degree (MD) is your Career Path — specialized credentials earned alongside your bachelor's degree. Each track focuses intensely on a single, professionally applicable subject to sharpen your expertise and strengthen your career profile.

What Is a Micro Degree?
Unlike a traditional degree that covers a broad range of topics, a Micro Degree (MD) is an intensive, focused program in a single, professionally applicable subject. By completing specific required courses and extracurricular activities, students earn a recognized credential that demonstrates specialized expertise to future employers.

--- Chunk 9146 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Content:
Content:
The Lithuanian Ministry of Education officially approved a 2+2 Joint Degree Program between Dongseo University (DSU) and Mykolas Romeris University (MRU) in the field of Informatics and Digital Contents. It was launched in September of 2014. Students admitted to the joint degree program take fundamental courses in their major along with Korean language courses at MRU for the first two years of the program. Then they complete the remaining two years of the program at DSU.

--- Chunk 9148 ---

Content:
Petra Christian University (PCU) is a major private Christian university in Surabaya, Indonesia, established in 1961. PCU and DSU launched a 2+2 Joint Degree Program in November of 2014. Degrees from both universities will be awarded to students who complete two years of study at PCU and two years of study at DSU in the field of digital contents.

✦ Career Path Program
A Micro Degree (MD) is your Career Path — specialized credentials earned alongside your bachelor's degree. Each track focuses intensely on a single, professionally applicable subject to sharpen your expertise and strengthen your career profile.

Content:
What Is a Micro Degree?
Unlike a traditional degree that covers a broad range of topics, a Micro Degree (MD) is an intensive, focused program in a single, professionally applicable subject. By completing specific required courses and extracurricular activities, students earn a recognized credential that demonstrates specialized expertise to future employers.

This initiative aims to strengthen cooperation between local universities and the region by cultivating globally competitive talents with digital transformation (DX) capabilities.

2025년도 한국어 TOPIK 시험 대비를 위한 TOPIK 특강이 진행됩니다.이번 특강은 TOPIK 10월 18일, 11월 16일에 실시하는 공인 TOPIK 시험 직전 대비반으로학생 여러분의 시험 등급 향상에 큰 도움이 될 것입니다.10월, 11월에 있을 시험 일정에 맞춰 2회 진행될 계획입니다.10월(1차)에 수강하지 못하는 학생들은 11월(2차) 강의를 꼭! 신청해주세요.학생 여러분들의 많은 관심과 참여 바랍니다.프로그램명: 2025 TOPIK 특강(1차)프로그램 기간: 10월 셋째주(13~17 중)일정: 주중 2시간 특강 2일(총 4시간) (정확한 시간은 미정)강의는 대면 강의(오프라인 강의)로 진행됩니다. 온라인 강의가 아닙니다.프로그램 신청은 추후 안내될 예정입니다.게시판을 잘 확인해 주세요.특강과 관련하여 문의가 있다면 아래의 연락처로 문의주시길 바랍니다.이메일: dsu.rise.global@gmail.com문의처: 뉴밀레니엄관 8층 라이즈사업단 유준욱The 2025

U-Start Programme is a special credit-transfer programme between Asia Pacific University (APU) and Dongseo University (DSU) which allows the students of DSU to study their 1st year in APU through credit-transfer courses in APU Foundation Programme in Malaysia before going to Korea to complete the rest of 3 years at DSU. Students need to be registered at DSU. All fees are payable to DSU in Korea for Year 1.

2025 International Day - Multicultural Festival을 소개합니다.이번에 RISE 사업단에서는 사상다문화센터와 합동하여'2025 사상강변축제'에서 음식 부스를 열 계획입니다.학생 여러분께서는 부스에 방문하여 축제를 즐길 수도 있으며,음식 조리 및 서빙 봉사로 축제에 참여할 수 있습니다.참가 신청한 학생들에게는 RISE 음식 부스에서 사용할 수 있는 쿠폰을 제공하오니,학생 여러분들의 많은 관심과 참여 바랍니다.1. 프로그램명: International Day - Multicultural Festival2. 프로그램 기간: 9월 20일(토)~21일(일)3. 봉사시간 및 모집인원 ① 9월 20일(토) 11:00 ~ 14:00 / 5명 모집 ② 9월 20일(토) 17:00 ~ 20:00 / 5명 모집 ③ 9월 21일(일) 11:00 ~ 14:00 / 5명 모집 ④ 9월 21일(일) 17:00 ~ 20:00 / 5명 모집4. 지원내용 ① 봉사 참여 학생:

In the Motion Graphics Design track, you’ll explore how movement, timing, and visual storytelling create powerful digital narratives. You’ll develop advanced skills in animation, compositing, and time-based media production using industry-standard creative tools, while experimenting with interactive and real-time visual systems. Through studio projects, you’ll learn how motion graphics shape communication across advertising, digital displays, entertainment media, and immersive environments.

Game Server Programming
A game server is a server which is the authoritative source of events in a multiplayer video game. The server transmits enough data about its internal state to allow its connected clients to maintain their own accurate version of the game world for display to players. They also receive and process each player's input. Students learn all techniques used in the game server.

The Department of Game Development offers six types of tracks according to industry standards and needs. Apart from traditional degrees covering a wide range of knowledge and practice areas in game technology, tracks focus on a specialist area of professional application. It is designed for technical experts in the fields of game client, game server, game databases and game AI. The goal of this Track is for students to develop more professionalism as beginning experts in each field, to produce

Content:
• Purpose
GP101 Lab is a research group dedicated to exploring and advancing the art and science of game development using Unity. Our primary goal is to cultivate student creativity, technical proficiency, and collaborative skills by designing, prototyping, and developing original games. We aim to bridge academic learning with real-world application through hands-on projects, workshops, and industry engagement.

7. 함께하는 튜티(외국인학생)의 구성은 어떻게 되나요? 

답변

--- Chunk 8517 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 6559 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000258
Content:

--- Chunk 10381 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 8518 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:

--- Chunk 10382 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
매칭되는 튜티는 크게 오프라인으로 만날 수 있는 교내 외국인학생과 온라인으로 만날 수 있는 해외 외국인학생으로 나뉩니다. 1. 교내 외국인학생동서대학교 International College 소속 외국인 학생이 가장 다수입니다. 베트남, 우즈베키스탄, 인도네시아, 리투아니아, 인도 등 10여개국에서 온 많은 외국인 학생들이 우리 학교에서 유학 중입니다. 모국어가 영어는 아니지만 영어로 전공과정을 이수 중인 영어트랙 학생들인 만큼 영어로 유창하게 소통이 가능합니다. 이 외에 중국의 여러 협정대학 학생들이 다수 있으며, 일본, 태국 등 초청 및 교환학생들도 본 프로그램에서 만날 수 있습니다. 이 경우 중국어, 일본어, 태국어 등 각자 모국어로 소통하게 됩니다.  그리고 동서대학교 외국어교육원에서 한국어 어학연수 중인 외국인학생들이 참여하는 회차도 있습니다.  2. 해외 외국인학생동서대학교는 해외 각지의 세종학당과 협력하고 있습니다. 인도네시아 수라바야 세종학당, 러시아 아스트라한

각지의 세종학당과 협력하고 있습니다. 인도네시아 수라바야 세종학당, 러시아 아스트라한 세종학당, 리투아니아 빌뉴스 세종학당의 학생들과 작년 한 해 꾸준히 Go, Global! 활동을 함께했습니다. 모두 온라인으로 만나며 보통 zoom을 활용합니다. 한국어를 배우고 있는 학생들이라서 한국어로 대부분 소통이 가능한 경우도 있고, 초급 수준인 경우 영어로 소통합니다. 시차가 있어 서로 배려하며 만나는 시간을 조정해야 하는 특징이 있고, 고등학생이나 직장인 학생이 매칭되기도 합니다. 프로그램을 지원할 때 참고해 주세요! ^^

6. 학습포인트(튜터 3점, 튜티 1점)는 일괄 지급되나요?  

답변

- 아닙니다. 튜터링 활동을 성실하게 했는지를 확인한 후 그 결과에 따라 차등 지급합니다.따라서 주어진 활동을 다 하지 못한 경우 학습포인트가 차감될 수 있습니다.

질문

5. 규칙적으로 활동하지 않고 일정 기간에 몰아서 활동을 해도 되나요?  

답변

- 아닙니다. 1주에 1회를 기본으로 합니다. 불가피한 경우 한 주에 2회까지는 가능하지만 그 이상 몰아서 한꺼번에 활동을 하는 것은 인정되지 않습니다.

질문

4. 카카오톡이나 DM을 주고받는 것만으로도 튜터링 활동으로 인정되나요? 

답변

--- Chunk 10385 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
4. 카카오톡이나 DM을 주고받는 것만으로도 튜터링 활동으로 인정되나요? 

답변

- 아닙니다. 튜터링 활동은 원래 대면 활동이 기본입니다. 불가피한 상황이 아니라면 이 규칙을 지켜주세요.

질문

답변

--- Chunk 10386 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
3. 활동기록표 제출은 언제, 어떻게 해야 하나요?

답변

활동기록표는 활동이 완료 된 후 담당자 이메일를 통해 제출합니다.* 홈페이지에서 파일을 다운로드 한 후, 한 활동을 정리하여 제출하면 됩니다.* 만약 제출 기간이 되었는데 부분적으로 진행된 상황이라면 그때까지 했던 활동만 정리해서 정해진 기간 내에 제출하도록 하세요.

질문

2. 튜티링 활동 1회의 활동 시간 기준은 어떻게 되나요? 

답변

- 학기 중에는 1주에 1시간 활동하는 것을 권장합니다. (기준 : 5주 동안 총 5시간 이상)

질문

1.튜티링 활동은 총 몇 회 해야 하나요? 

답변

--- Chunk 8522 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
질문

1.튜티링 활동은 총 몇 회 해야 하나요? 

답변

- 튜터링 활동은 총 5주에 걸쳐 진행됩니다.그 기간 안에 총 5회를 마무리하면 됩니다.예시) 1주에 1회(1시간)

■ 지원대상 Eligibility - 창업에 관심 있는 동서대학교 학부생 또는 대학원생을 대표학생으로 하는 창업동아리   Startup clubs led by a representative student (undergraduate or graduate) of Dongseo University who has an interest in entrepreneurship - 동서대학교에 재학 중인 학생을 대상으로 지원   Applicants must be currently enrolled students at Dongseo University.  ※ RISE 창업스쿨 창업동아리와 교내 타 창업동아리 프로그램 간 중복 아이템 신청 불가     Duplicate application of the same startup item with other on-campus startup club programs is not allowed.  ■ 창업동아리 구성 요건 Startup Club

--- Chunk 10769 ---

Content:
U-Start Programme is a special credit-transfer programme between Asia Pacific University(APU) and Dongseo University (DSU) which allows the students of DSU to study their 1st year in APU through credit-transfer courses in APU Foundation Programme in Malaysia before going to Korea to complete the rest of 3 years at DSU. Students need to be registered at DSU.

Please don't forget to apply for re-entry permit at least one week before you leave.After approval, you can print out the approval confirmation document. You should bring it with you when you leave.You should do it online at the hikorea website

Content:
Content:
- The purpose of this program is to develop proficiency in Korean language communication across all four language skills: speaking, listening, reading, and writing. The program includes courses on Korean culture and business Korean, taking into account various Korean language usage environments and genres such as pronunciation, grammar, rhetoric, and composition. Through this program, students will gain knowledge and skills in Korean language communication to achieve their goals.

English TrackIn the 1st year, students establish their language foundation through intensive Korean courses within the liberal arts education program. Graduation Requirements
To graduate, students must complete at least 120 credits (including a minimum of 60 major credits, 30 general education credits (including 12 required credits), and 30 elective credits), pass the comprehensive graduation exam, and obtain at least Level 4 on the Test of Proficiency in Korean (TOPIK).

Graduation Project
Build and submit a working system — software, hardware, or a combination of both — and document it as a written thesis.
Examples
Web / mobile application  ·  AI-based system  ·  IoT device  ·  Cloud service  ·  Game  ·  Embedded system

Research Thesis
Investigate an existing topic in computer science, conduct your research, and write up your findings as a formal academic thesis.
Examples
AI / ML algorithm study  ·  Security analysis  ·  Performance comparison  ·  Software architecture review

2025년도 한국어 TOPIK 시험 대비를 위한 TOPIK 특강이 진행됩니다.이번 특강은 TOPIK 10월 18일에 실시하는 공인 TOPIK 시험 직전 대비반으로학생 여러분의 시험 등급 향상에 큰 도움이 될 것입니다.프로그램명: 2025 TOPIK 특강(1차)프로그램 기간: 10월 15일(수), 17일(금)일정: 13:00~15:00(2시간) 특강 2일(총 4시간)수강인원: 20명(선착순)강의실: International College 603호신청링크: https://forms.gle/w5ZB9BNjL74CZJNm6강의는 대면 강의(오프라인 강의)로 진행됩니다. 온라인 강의가 아닙니다.응답을 제출한 이메일로 선정 여부를 알려드립니다.이메일을 잘 확인해주세요.특강과 관련하여 문의가 있다면 아래의 연락처로 문의 주시길 바랍니다.이메일: dsu.rise.global@gmail.com문의처: 뉴밀레니엄관 8층 라이즈사업단 유준욱

Industry-academia cooperation Project
The industry-academia project refers to a formalization process within the undergraduate department or a project through industry-academia cooperation. Industry-academia projects focus on what is as consistent with the undergraduate structure as possible, and should also be clear about the benefits and use of final results for students who participated in the project.

Brand Project

The brand project begins with the suggestion of a professor or student, and after the minimum planning stage is carried out, accurate goals must be established and announced to the students.

Micro Degree (MD)
✦ Career Path Program
A Micro Degree (MD) is your Career Path — specialized credentials earned alongside your bachelor's degree. Each track focuses intensely on a single, professionally applicable subject to sharpen your expertise and strengthen your career profile.

What Is a Micro Degree?

--- Chunk 12190 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt

Content:
What Is a Micro Degree?
Unlike a traditional degree that covers a broad range of topics, a Micro Degree (MD) is an intensive, focused program in a single, professionally applicable subject. By completing specific required courses and extracurricular activities, students earn a recognized credential that demonstrates specialized expertise to future employers.

Content:
The Lithuanian Ministry of Education officially approved a 2+2 Joint Degree Program between Dongseo University (DSU) and Mykolas Romeris University (MRU) in the field of Informatics and Digital Contents. It was launched in September of 2014. Students admitted to the joint degree program take fundamental courses in their major along with Korean language courses at MRU for the first two years of the program. Then they complete the remaining two years of the program at DSU.

Content:
What Is a Micro Degree?
Unlike a traditional degree that covers a broad range of topics, a Micro Degree (MD) is an intensive, focused program in a single, professionally applicable subject. By completing specific required courses and extracurricular activities, students earn a recognized credential that demonstrates specialized expertise to future employers.

Content:
2025년도 한국어 TOPIK 시험 대비를 위한 TOPIK 특강이 진행됩니다.이번 특강은 TOPIK 10월 18일, 11월 16일에 실시하는 공인 TOPIK 시험 직전 대비반으로학생 여러분의 시험 등급 향상에 큰 도움이 될 것입니다.10월, 11월에 있을 시험 일정에 맞춰 2회 진행될 계획입니다.10월(1차)에 수강하지 못하는 학생들은 11월(2차) 강의를 꼭! 신청해주세요.학생 여러분들의 많은 관심과 참여 바랍니다.프로그램명: 2025 TOPIK 특강(1차)프로그램 기간: 10월 셋째주(13~17 중)일정: 주중 2시간 특강 2일(총 4시간) (정확한 시간은 미정)강의는 대면 강의(오프라인 강의)로 진행됩니다. 온라인 강의가 아닙니다.프로그램 신청은 추후 안내될 예정입니다.게시판을 잘 확인해 주세요.특강과 관련하여 문의가 있다면 아래의 연락처로 문의주시길 바랍니다.이메일: dsu.rise.global@gmail.com문의처: 뉴밀레니엄관 8층 라이즈사업단 유준욱The 2025

Content:
--- Chunk 10307 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
U-Start Programme is a special credit-transfer programme between Asia Pacific University (APU) and Dongseo University (DSU) which allows the students of DSU to study their 1st year in APU through credit-transfer courses in APU Foundation Programme in Malaysia before going to Korea to complete the rest of 3 years at DSU. Students need to be registered at DSU. All fees are payable to DSU in Korea for Year 1.

Content:
DSU is one of the leading universities in Busan, South Korea. The Dongseo Educational Foundation has given rise to three different institutions of higher education: Kyungnam College of Information and Technology (1965), Dongseo University (1992), and Busan Digital University (2002). Together these three institutions – KIT, DSU and BDU– educate around 20,000 students annually and employ over 1,000 professors.

--- Chunk 12779 ---

Content:
In the Motion Graphics Design track, you’ll explore how movement, timing, and visual storytelling create powerful digital narratives. You’ll develop advanced skills in animation, compositing, and time-based media production using industry-standard creative tools, while experimenting with interactive and real-time visual systems. Through studio projects, you’ll learn how motion graphics shape communication across advertising, digital displays, entertainment media, and immersive environments.

Game Server Programming
A game server is a server which is the authoritative source of events in a multiplayer video game. The server transmits enough data about its internal state to allow its connected clients to maintain their own accurate version of the game world for display to players. They also receive and process each player's input. Students learn all techniques used in the game server.

Content:
• Purpose
GP101 Lab is a research group dedicated to exploring and advancing the art and science of game development using Unity. Our primary goal is to cultivate student creativity, technical proficiency, and collaborative skills by designing, prototyping, and developing original games. We aim to bridge academic learning with real-world application through hands-on projects, workshops, and industry engagement.

--- Chunk 10840 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
This program is a tutoring program in which Dongseo University Korean students help foreign students learn the Korean language and get to know Korean culture, and in return foreign students can help Korean students understand their language and learn their culture. During the semester, the program runs for a total of 5 to 10 weeks, 1:1 matching Korean and foreign students work together.

A total of 441 students (226 Korean students, 215 foreign students) participated in this program in 2021, and a total of 174 students (87 Korean students, 87 foreign students) participated in this program in 2022. We engage in face-to-face activities with foreign students enrolled in Dongseo University, and engage in non-face-to-face activities (using zoom, etc.) with students at overseas universities and King Sejong Institute. Students from PCU Surabaya King Sejong Institute in Indonesia, MRU

--- Chunk 8385 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000254
Content:
본 프로그램은 동서대 재학생들과 외국인 학생들이 자국의 언어와 문화를 알려주며 소통하는 튜터링 프로그램으로 2020년 여름, 파일럿 프로그램으로 처음 시작하여 매년 2회차로 꾸준히 운영 중입니다. 학기 중 5주간 운영되며 1:1로 매칭된 한국인튜터-외국인튜티가 함께 활동합니다. 참여 학생들은 다양한 외국어(영어, 중국어, 일본어 등)를 매개로 하여 온/오프라인으로 만나 1주 1회 이상 튜터링을 진행하며, 서로의 언어와 문화를 교류하면서 외국어 실력을 키우게 됩니다.

지난 2021년에는 총 441명(한국인 학생 226명, 외국인 학생 215명), 2022년에는 총 174명(한국인 87명, 외국인 87명)이 본 프로그램에 참여했습니다. 동서대학교에 재학 중인 외국인학생들과는 대면 중심의 활동을 하며, 국외 대학 및 세종학당의 학생들과는 비대면(zoom 등 활용)으로 활동을 합니다. 인도네시아 PCU 수라바야세종학당, 리투아니아 MRU 빌뉴스세종학당, 러시아 ASU 아스트라한세종학당, 미국 세인트메리대학의 샌안토니오세종학당, 중국 광동외어외무대학, 일본 리츠메이칸대학의 학생들이 그동안 함께 했습니다.

7. 함께하는 튜티(외국인학생)의 구성은 어떻게 되나요? 

답변

--- Chunk 11201 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 8659 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000258
Content:

--- Chunk 13625 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 11202 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:

--- Chunk 13626 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
매칭되는 튜티는 크게 오프라인으로 만날 수 있는 교내 외국인학생과 온라인으로 만날 수 있는 해외 외국인학생으로 나뉩니다. 1. 교내 외국인학생동서대학교 International College 소속 외국인 학생이 가장 다수입니다. 베트남, 우즈베키스탄, 인도네시아, 리투아니아, 인도 등 10여개국에서 온 많은 외국인 학생들이 우리 학교에서 유학 중입니다. 모국어가 영어는 아니지만 영어로 전공과정을 이수 중인 영어트랙 학생들인 만큼 영어로 유창하게 소통이 가능합니다. 이 외에 중국의 여러 협정대학 학생들이 다수 있으며, 일본, 태국 등 초청 및 교환학생들도 본 프로그램에서 만날 수 있습니다. 이 경우 중국어, 일본어, 태국어 등 각자 모국어로 소통하게 됩니다.  그리고 동서대학교 외국어교육원에서 한국어 어학연수 중인 외국인학생들이 참여하는 회차도 있습니다.  2. 해외 외국인학생동서대학교는 해외 각지의 세종학당과 협력하고 있습니다. 인도네시아 수라바야 세종학당, 러시아 아스트라한

--- Chunk 13627 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 11203 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 8660 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000258
Content:
각지의 세종학당과 협력하고 있습니다. 인도네시아 수라바야 세종학당, 러시아 아스트라한 세종학당, 리투아니아 빌뉴스 세종학당의 학생들과 작년 한 해 꾸준히 Go, Global! 활동을 함께했습니다. 모두 온라인으로 만나며 보통 zoom을 활용합니다. 한국어를 배우고 있는 학생들이라서 한국어로 대부분 소통이 가능한 경우도 있고, 초급 수준인 경우 영어로 소통합니다. 시차가 있어 서로 배려하며 만나는 시간을 조정해야 하는 특징이 있고, 고등학생이나 직장인 학생이 매칭되기도 합니다. 프로그램을 지원할 때 참고해 주세요! ^^

Content:
6. 학습포인트(튜터 3점, 튜티 1점)는 일괄 지급되나요?  

답변

- 아닙니다. 튜터링 활동을 성실하게 했는지를 확인한 후 그 결과에 따라 차등 지급합니다.따라서 주어진 활동을 다 하지 못한 경우 학습포인트가 차감될 수 있습니다.

질문

5. 규칙적으로 활동하지 않고 일정 기간에 몰아서 활동을 해도 되나요?  

답변

- 아닙니다. 1주에 1회를 기본으로 합니다. 불가피한 경우 한 주에 2회까지는 가능하지만 그 이상 몰아서 한꺼번에 활동을 하는 것은 인정되지 않습니다.

질문

4. 카카오톡이나 DM을 주고받는 것만으로도 튜터링 활동으로 인정되나요? 

답변

--- Chunk 13629 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
4. 카카오톡이나 DM을 주고받는 것만으로도 튜터링 활동으로 인정되나요? 

답변

- 아닙니다. 튜터링 활동은 원래 대면 활동이 기본입니다. 불가피한 상황이 아니라면 이 규칙을 지켜주세요.

질문

답변

--- Chunk 13630 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
3. 활동기록표 제출은 언제, 어떻게 해야 하나요?

답변

활동기록표는 활동이 완료 된 후 담당자 이메일를 통해 제출합니다.* 홈페이지에서 파일을 다운로드 한 후, 한 활동을 정리하여 제출하면 됩니다.* 만약 제출 기간이 되었는데 부분적으로 진행된 상황이라면 그때까지 했던 활동만 정리해서 정해진 기간 내에 제출하도록 하세요.

질문

2. 튜티링 활동 1회의 활동 시간 기준은 어떻게 되나요? 

답변

- 학기 중에는 1주에 1시간 활동하는 것을 권장합니다. (기준 : 5주 동안 총 5시간 이상)

질문

1.튜티링 활동은 총 몇 회 해야 하나요? 

답변

--- Chunk 11206 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
질문

1.튜티링 활동은 총 몇 회 해야 하나요? 

답변

- 튜터링 활동은 총 5주에 걸쳐 진행됩니다.그 기간 안에 총 5회를 마무리하면 됩니다.예시) 1주에 1회(1시간)

Contact Usthis website is optimized for chrome browser

 What is a U-START Programme?

--- Chunk 14013 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
U-Start Programme is a special credit-transfer programme between Asia Pacific University(APU) and Dongseo University (DSU) which allows the students of DSU to study their 1st year in APU through credit-transfer courses in APU Foundation Programme in Malaysia before going to Korea to complete the rest of 3 years at DSU. Students need to be registered at DSU.

Content:
2025년도 한국어 TOPIK 시험 대비를 위한 TOPIK 특강이 진행됩니다.이번 특강은 TOPIK 11월 16일에 실시하는 공인 TOPIK 시험 직전 대비반으로학생 여러분의 시험 등급 향상에 큰 도움이 될 것입니다.프로그램명: 2025 TOPIK 특강(2차)프로그램 기간: 11월 12일(수), 14일(금)일정: 13:00~15:00(2시간) 특강 2일(총 4시간)수강인원: 20명(선착순)강의실: International College 605호신청링크: https://forms.gle/uPUBSCzHJQ2YpcHi9강의는 대면 강의(오프라인 강의)로 진행됩니다. 온라인 강의가 아닙니다.응답을 제출한 이메일로 선정 여부를 알려드립니다.이메일을 잘 확인해주세요.특강과 관련하여 문의가 있다면 아래의 연락처로 문의 주시길 바랍니다.이메일: dsu.rise.global@gmail.com문의처: 뉴밀레니엄관 8층 라이즈사업단 유준욱

I. INTRODUCTION 
1.1. OUTLINE OF THE EVALUATION PROCESS 
The field of study evaluations in Lithuanian higher education institutions (HEIs) are based on the following: 
● Procedure for the External Evaluation and Accreditation of Studies, Evaluation Areas and 
Indicators, approved by the Minister of Education, Science, and Sport;

--- Chunk 15423 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
● Methodology of External Evaluation of Study Fields approved by the Director of the Centre for 
Quality Assessment in Higher Education (SKVC);

--- Chunk 15424 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 12667 ---
Source: data\MRU_Informatika_2024_išvadų projektas_MRU comments_5.7.24_20241105.pdf
Content:
Quality Assessment in Higher Education (SKVC); 
● Standards and Guidelines for Quality Assurance in the European Higher Education Area (ESG). 
The evaluation is intended to support HEIs in continuous enhancement of their study process and to inform 
the public about the quality of programmes within the field of study.

--- Chunk 15425 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
The object of the evaluation is all programmes within a specific field of study. A separate assessment is 
given for each study cycle.

--- Chunk 15426 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 12668 ---
Source: data\MRU_Informatika_2024_išvadų projektas_MRU comments_5.7.24_20241105.pdf
Content:
given for each study cycle. 
The evaluation process consists of the following main steps: 1) Self -evaluation and production of a self -
evaluation report (SER) prepared by an HEI; 2) A site visit by the review panel to the HEI; 3) The external 
evaluation report (EER) production by the review panel; 4) EER review by the HEI; 5) EER review by the

--- Chunk 15427 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Study Evaluation Committee; 6) Accreditation decision taken by SKVC; 7) Appeal procedure (if initiated by

--- Chunk 15428 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 12669 ---
Source: data\MRU_Informatika_2024_išvadų projektas_MRU comments_5.7.24_20241105.pdf
Content:
the HEI); 8) Follow -up activities, which include the production of a Progress Report on Recommendations 
Implementation by the HEI. 
The main outcome of the evaluation process is the EER prepared by the review panel. The HEI is forwarded 
the draft EER for feedback on any factual mistakes. The draft report is then subject to approval by the

--- Chunk 15429 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
external Study Evaluation Committee, operating under SKVC. Once approved, the EER serves as the basis

Content:
for an accreditation decision. If an HEI disagrees with the outcome of the evaluation, it can file an 
appeal.On the basis of the approved EER, SKVC takes one of the following accreditation decisions: 
● Accreditation granted for 7 years  if all evaluation areas are evaluated as exceptional (5 points), 
very good (4 points), or good (3 points).

1.4. BACKGROUND OF THE REVIEW  
Overview of the HEI 
Mykolas Romeris University (MRU) is a state university established in 2004 as a successor of the Law 
University of Lithuania. It offers 68 study programmes (24 Bachelor’s programmes, 43 Master’s 
programmes and one professional study programme), primarily (95%) in social sciences, mainly Law,

--- Chunk 15443 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Psychology, Economics, Philology, Education and Management. MRU is part of the ERUA alliance (European 
Alliance of Reform Universities).

Alliance of Reform Universities). 
 
Overview of the field of study 
MRU started to deliver programmes in Informatics in 2014 with the Bachelor’s degree programme called 
“Game Development and Digital Animation”, which is a joint study programme with Dongseo University 
(DSU) in South Korea in an arrangement where MRU teaches the two first years of the programme and DSU

I. 서론 
1.1. 평가 프로세스 개요 
리투아니아 고등교육기관(HEI)의 학업 분야 평가는 다음 사항을 기준으로 합니다. 
● 교육과학체육부 장관이 승인한 연구, 평가 분야 및 지표의 외부 평가 및 인증 절차. 
● 고등교육 질 평가 센터(SKVC) 소장이 승인한 연구 분야의 외부 평가 방법론 
● 유럽 고등교육 지역(ESG)의 품질 보증에 대한 표준 및 지침. 
평가의 목적은 고등교육기관의 학습 과정을 지속적으로 개선하도록 지원하고, 해당 학문 분야의 
프로그램 질을 대중에게 알리는 것입니다. 
평가의 대상은 특정 학문 분야 내의 모든 프로그램입니다. 각 연구 주기에 대해 별도의 평가가 
제공됩니다.

제공됩니다.

보고서(SER) 작성; 2) 검토 패널이 HEI 에 대한 현장 방문; 3) 검토 패널이 외부 평가 보고서(EER) 작성; 4)

1.4. 검토 배경  
HEI 개요 
Mykolas Romeris University(MRU) 는 리투아니아 법학 대학의 후신으로 2004 년에 설립된 국립 
대학입니다. 68 개의 학업 프로그램(학사 프로그램 24 개, 석사 프로그램 43 개, 전문 학업 프로그램 
1 개)을 제공하며, 주로(95%) 사회 과학, 주로 법학, 심리학, 경제학, 문헌학, 교육학 및 경영학을 
전공합니다. MRU 는 ERUA 연합(European Alliance of Reform Universities)의 일부입니다. 
 
연구 분야 개요 
MRU 는 2014 년에 "게임 개발 및 디지털 애니메이션"이라는 학사 학위 프로그램으로 정보학

5-1. 예비 졸업생은 포트폴리오와 졸업 과제로 구성된 2차례 정기 평가(1차와 최종 평가)
를 통해 평가받는다. (첨부 2: 평가 기준표 (각 평가 영역별 가중치 적용) 참조) 
  (1) 첫 번째 평가는 최종 평가를 위한 개발 단계를 검토하는 것으로, 최종 평가에는 영
향을 미치지 않는다. 
  (2) 포트폴리오 및 졸업 과제 평가의 최종 점수가 70점 미만일 경우, 탈락이 확정되어 
정규 평가 절차를 다시 진행해야 한다. 
  (3) 또한, 최종 평가에서 정성적·정량적 평가의 총점이 70점을 넘더라도, 개인 평가 영
역, 졸업작품 평가 영역에서 얻은 점수가 40% 미만이면 평가를 통과하지 못한다.

5-2. 졸업 평가 결과 발표 
  (1) 졸업 평가 위원회의 최종 결과는 일반에 공개되지 않으며, 졸업 평가 위원회 위원
장이 국제대학에 통보한다.  
  (2) 국제대학은 정해진 학업 일정에 따라 학생들에게 행정 통지를 제공한다. 
 
6. 졸업 작품 및 교내 작품 소유권 규정 및 기타 사항 
6-1. 졸업 작품 콘텐츠의 저작권은 학생에게 있으며, 학과가 인접 권리를 보유한다. 
6-2. 졸업 작품 중 비디오의 경우, 동서대학교 상징 로고를 반드시 삽입해야 한다. 
6-3. 학생들의 작품은 학교가 상업적인 목적이 아닌 홍보 용도로 자유롭게 사용할 수 있
다. 학교가 상업적인 용도로 작품을 사용하는 경우, 학생과 적절한 법률 절차를 거처야 
한다.

The Lithuanian Ministry of Education officially approved a 2+2 Joint Degree Program between Dongseo University (DSU) and Mykolas Romeris University (MRU) in the field of Informatics and Digital Contents. Career Tracks
There are two main types of programmers in game development: client developers and server developers. This 2+2 program offers a specialized curriculum designed for both of these roles.

Game Client Developer

1. Background and purpose.
1-1. Establish graduation rules and suggest the necessary standards for application.

Industry-academia cooperation Project
The industry-academia project refers to a formalization process within the undergraduate department or a project through industry-academia cooperation. Industry-academia projects focus on what is as consistent with the undergraduate structure as possible, and should also be clear about the benefits and use of final results for students who participated in the project.

Brand Project
The brand project aims to enhance the status of the major as a special purpose project. Its purpose, such as winning an international contest or commercialization through the next branding, should be accurate. The brand project begins with the suggestion of a professor or student, and after the minimum planning stage is carried out, accurate goals must be established and announced to the students.

What Is a Micro Degree?
Unlike a traditional degree that covers a broad range of topics, a Micro Degree (MD) is an intensive, focused program in a single, professionally applicable subject. By completing specific required courses and extracurricular activities, students earn a recognized credential that demonstrates specialized expertise to future employers.

Intakes: March / September

ENTRY REQUIREMENTS

ENTRY REQUIREMENTS

5 Credits in at least 5 subjects at SPM level with a minimum of a pass in Bahasa Malaysia and Sejarah (History)

5 Credits (Grade C & above) in at least 5 subjects at IGCSE/ O-Levels

ENGLISH REQUIREMENTS

MALAYSIAN & INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS

Min. IELTS 5.5.

--- Chunk 16540 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
U-Start Programme is a special credit-transfer programme between Asia Pacific University (APU) and Dongseo University (DSU) which allows the students of DSU to study their 1st year in APU through credit-transfer courses in APU Foundation Programme in Malaysia before going to Korea to complete the rest of 3 years at DSU. Students need to be registered at DSU. All fees are payable to DSU in Korea for Year 1.

Content:
DSU is one of the leading universities in Busan, South Korea. The Dongseo Educational Foundation has given rise to three different institutions of higher education: Kyungnam College of Information and Technology (1965), Dongseo University (1992), and Busan Digital University (2002). Together these three institutions – KIT, DSU and BDU– educate around 20,000 students annually and employ over 1,000 professors.

UndergraduateU - START PROGRAM with APUOverview

Overview
 What is a U-START Programme?

--- Chunk 16614 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Overview
 What is a U-START Programme?

U-Start Programme is a special credit-transfer programme between Asia Pacific University(APU) and Dongseo University (DSU) which allows the students of DSU to study their 1st year in APU through credit-transfer courses in APU Foundation Programme in Malaysia before going to Korea to complete the rest of 3 years at DSU. Students need to be registered at DSU.

Who is APU?

Graduation Requirements
Students in the Digital Design program must complete the following requirements in order to graduate.

Completion of 120 total credits
Successful completion of 60 credits of major courses
Submission of a Graduation Portfolio
Participation in the Digital Design Graduation Exhibition

--- Chunk 16709 ---

Content:
Graduation Requirement

--- Chunk 13548 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654
Content:
Graduation Requirement
 

Graduation Requirement
Everything you need to know to successfully complete your Graduation Project or Research Thesis and meet all requirements for graduation from the Computer Science program.

Requirement Type
Project or Thesis
Graduation Project or Research Thesis — choose one

Max Team Size
3
Individual or team project — up to 3 students per team

--- Chunk 16710 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Minimum Pass Grade
Grade C
Grade C (70–79 pts) or above — all judges must agree

--- Chunk 13549 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654
Content:
English Requirement
At Admission
Score submitted on entry remains valid throughout enrollment

1
Definition

--- Chunk 16711 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
1
Definition

Graduation Project
Build and submit a working system — software, hardware, or a combination of both — and document it as a written thesis.
Examples
Web / mobile application  ·  AI-based system  ·  IoT device  ·  Cloud service  ·  Game  ·  Embedded system

--- Chunk 16712 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 13550 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654
Content:
Research Thesis
Investigate an existing topic in computer science, conduct your research, and write up your findings as a formal academic thesis.
Examples
AI / ML algorithm study  ·  Security analysis  ·  Performance comparison  ·  Software architecture review

2
How It Works — Process & Timeline

--- Chunk 16713 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
2
How It Works — Process & Timeline

--- Chunk 13551 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654
Content:
2
How It Works — Process & Timeline

Work Individually or Form a Team
You may work individually or form a team of up to 3 students. Submit your project or thesis proposal by the announced deadline, under your advisory professor's guidance.

--- Chunk 16714 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Develop the Project / Conduct Research
Work on your project or research throughout the semester with ongoing supervision from your advisory professor.

--- Chunk 13552 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654
Content:
Interim Presentation
Present your progress to the judging panel. Incorporate the judges' feedback before the final submission.

Final Presentation and Submission
Submit your completed thesis and present it to the judging committee for final evaluation.

--- Chunk 16715 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Result
Pass (Grade C or above from all judges) and you are cleared for graduation. Fail and you may re-present during a separately announced re-evaluation period.

3
Evaluation Criteria

--- Chunk 13553 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654
Content:
3
Evaluation Criteria

Judging Committee
2+ Professors
Two or more faculty members serve as judges. The advisory professor may also be included.

--- Chunk 16716 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Passing Grade
Grade C
All judges must individually award Grade C (70–79 pts) or above. A single judge below C means a fail.

Criteria Set By
Curriculum Committee
Evaluation criteria are set by the major curriculum committee each semester.

--- Chunk 13554 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654
Content:
Important: Failing the re-evaluation, or not submitting a thesis without a valid reason, results in exclusion from graduation for that semester.

Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt

4
Graduation Comprehensive Examination & Exemptions

Graduation Comprehensive Examination (D.U.S.R. Article 34)

All students must pass the Graduation Comprehensive Examination (Major courses). The exemptions below apply to most CS students:

Academic Roadmap
 

Academic Roadmap
Plan your academic journey with our comprehensive roadmap, tailored to your chosen track and designed to guide you from freshman year to graduation.

Graduation Requirements

Total Credits
120 credits

Liberal Education
30 credits

Major
60 credits

--- Chunk 13567 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000649
Content:
Liberal Education
30 credits

Major
60 credits

Others
30 credits
Liberal Ed, Major, or any other dept — your choice

--- Chunk 16734 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Major Only
Single major track (60 credits)

Double Major
Primary 36 + Secondary 36 credits

Minor
Primary 54 + Minor 18 credits

Major Only Track
• Complete 60+ credits in Computer Science major courses
• Focus on building deep expertise in your chosen specialization track (SW Development or AI Application)
• Remaining 30 credits can be used for electives or other departments

--- Chunk 16735 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 13568 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000649
Content:
Double Major Track
• Complete 36 credits in Computer Science (primary major)
• Complete 36 credits in another major (secondary major)
• Total of 72 major credits across both disciplines

Minor Track
• Complete 54 credits in Computer Science (primary major)
• Complete 18 credits in a minor field of study
• Total of 71 credits in major and minor combined

Graduation Requirements

Content:
• Purpose
GP101 Lab is a research group dedicated to exploring and advancing the art and science of game development using Unity. Our primary goal is to cultivate student creativity, technical proficiency, and collaborative skills by designing, prototyping, and developing original games. We aim to bridge academic learning with real-world application through hands-on projects, workshops, and industry engagement.

About Computer Science
Computer Science is constantly evolving, and it is an exciting time to be part of this dynamic, rapidly growing field. The International College Computer Science major aims to nurture highly qualified professionals equipped with the creative, hands-on skills necessary to lead the knowledge and information industry of the 21st century, including software development, AI, and cloud computing.

Career Paths
Our graduates pursue diverse career opportunities in the technology industry, from software development and AI engineering to entrepreneurship and advanced academic research. Our comprehensive education system, combining curricular and co-curricular programs, prepares students for three main career pathways: industry employment (including regional settlement), return to home country for career opportunities, and graduate school advancement.

中韩新媒体学院各位同学：大多数同学的外国人登录证已经办下来。目前International College办公室正在进行整理，预计于今日下午4点起开始发放。1. 领取时间： 4月 27日(周一) ~ 28日(周二)，16:00 ~ 18:002. 领取地点： IC楼 702号，IC办公室 3. 注意事项：必须由本人亲自领取。严禁他人代领。[领取后的重要注意事项]一、 谨防电信诈骗：     韩国公共机关（出入境管理事务所、法院、警察局等）绝不会通过个人手机联系学生要求发送登录证照片或询问登录证号码。请绝对不要提供个人信息。此外，近期冒充中国公共机关的诈骗电话也很多，请务必提高警惕。二、 妥善保管及使用    外国人登录证必须随身携带。在银行办理存折、银行卡或开通手机业务时，严禁提供登录证原件，应提交复印件。三、 个人信息变更申报    若登录证上的信息（韩国国内住址、姓名等）发生变更，必须在14日内向出入境管理事务所申报。如需帮助，请联系IC办公室柳老师。四、 出入境相关    假期出国（出境）时，也请务必随身携带外国人登录证原件。五、 遗失及补办

Hi Koreahttps://www.hikorea.go.kr/Main.pt하이코리아는 비자 및 출입국 관련 정보를 제공하는 공식 포털로, 외국인을 위한 종합 안내 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 출입국 관련 문의 및 상담을 위해 출입국콜센터(☎ 1345)를 이용할 수 있으며, 외국어 상담도 가능합니다.

Course Sequence Guide
The following roadmap shows the recommended course sequence for students. Use this as a guide to plan your 4-year academic journey.

Before You Start — Please Read

This roadmap is a recommended guideline, not a strict requirement.
Select the roadmap that matches your admission semester.
Course availability may vary by semester.
Consult your academic advisor.

Career Track

Students in the major can receive the following four Tracks upon completion of the given curriculum. In addition, we recommend that students explore various MDs from other interdisciplinary programs and acquire one or more additional ones.

--- Chunk 17766 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
Content:
- The purpose of this program is to develop proficiency in Korean language communication across all four language skills: speaking, listening, reading, and writing. The program includes courses on Korean culture and business Korean, taking into account various Korean language usage environments and genres such as pronunciation, grammar, rhetoric, and composition. Through this program, students will gain knowledge and skills in Korean language communication to achieve their goals.

Korean creative contents Track
- Through various texts, this intensive course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of humanities knowledge about Korean society, including culture, politics, economy, history, and literature. The purpose of this course is to enhance students' capacity for Korean cultural content as local experts, allowing them to assume their roles effectively.

Business Manager Track

Portfolio Document Requirements: Must include a Portfolio Study, a Resume, and Job Research.
Festival Entry: Animation Short Film projects must include a Festival certificate of entry.
Copyright: Copyright belongs to the student, while the department holds neighboring rights.

2026년 「지역특화형 비자 사업(지역특화형 우수인재)」 모집부산광역시는 우수한 외국인 인재 유치 및 정착을 위한 지역특화형 비자 사업을 실시하고 있습니다.이번 모집에 우수한 외국인 인재 여러분의 많은 관심과 참여 바랍니다.○ (모집유형) 지역특화형 우수인재(F-2-R)○ (모집인원) 105명(동구 32, 서구 30, 영도구 43) * 특정국가 30% 제한<구별 지역우수인재 모집인원>구 분합 계동 구서 구영도구비 고배정인원150505050 기 추천인원4518207 모집인원105323043 (베트남)(12)(3)(모집 종료)(9) ※ 모집인원 초과 접수 시 기본소양, 세부유형, 신청유형, 부산시 거주기간 점수를 합산하여 고득점 순 선발, 동점인 경우 ’부산시 거주기간-연령(연소자 순)-접수순서‘ 순으로 최종 선발○ (모집기간) ‘26. 3. 30.(월) 09:00 ~ 4. 17.(금) 18:00○ (접 수 처) 동구·서구·영도구청 지역특화형 비자 담당부서- 동구청 총무과(부산 동구

--- Chunk 17994 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
This program is a tutoring program in which Dongseo University Korean students help foreign students learn the Korean language and get to know Korean culture, and in return foreign students can help Korean students understand their language and learn their culture. During the semester, the program runs for a total of 5 to 10 weeks, 1:1 matching Korean and foreign students work together.

--- Chunk 17996 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
A total of 441 students (226 Korean students, 215 foreign students) participated in this program in 2021, and a total of 174 students (87 Korean students, 87 foreign students) participated in this program in 2022. We engage in face-to-face activities with foreign students enrolled in Dongseo University, and engage in non-face-to-face activities (using zoom, etc.) with students at overseas universities and King Sejong Institute. Students from PCU Surabaya King Sejong Institute in Indonesia, MRU

--- Chunk 17998 ---

--- Chunk 14553 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000254
Content:
본 프로그램은 동서대 재학생들과 외국인 학생들이 자국의 언어와 문화를 알려주며 소통하는 튜터링 프로그램으로 2020년 여름, 파일럿 프로그램으로 처음 시작하여 매년 2회차로 꾸준히 운영 중입니다. 학기 중 5주간 운영되며 1:1로 매칭된 한국인튜터-외국인튜티가 함께 활동합니다. 참여 학생들은 다양한 외국어(영어, 중국어, 일본어 등)를 매개로 하여 온/오프라인으로 만나 1주 1회 이상 튜터링을 진행하며, 서로의 언어와 문화를 교류하면서 외국어 실력을 키우게 됩니다.

--- Chunk 17999 ---
Source: data\rag_debug_chunks.txt
Content:
--- Chunk 14554 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000254
Content:
지난 2021년에는 총 441명(한국인 학생 226명, 외국인 학생 215명), 2022년에는 총 174명(한국인 87명, 외국인 87명)이 본 프로그램에 참여했습니다. 동서대학교에 재학 중인 외국인학생들과는 대면 중심의 활동을 하며, 국외 대학 및 세종학당의 학생들과는 비대면(zoom 등 활용)으로 활동을 합니다. 인도네시아 PCU 수라바야세종학당, 리투아니아 MRU 빌뉴스세종학당, 러시아 ASU 아스트라한세종학당, 미국 세인트메리대학의 샌안토니오세종학당, 중국 광동외어외무대학, 일본 리츠메이칸대학의 학생들이 그동안 함께 했습니다.

About
 

At Dongseo University’s Graduate School, International College manages three majors:
- Dept of Business Administration offering MA and PH.D degrees taught in English

- Dept of Visual Contents with Animation, Film and VFX tracks offering MA, MFA, and PH.D degrees taught in English
