7. 함께하는 튜티(외국인학생)의 구성은 어떻게 되나요? 

답변

--- Chunk 25071 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000258
Content:
매칭되는 튜티는 크게 오프라인으로 만날 수 있는 교내 외국인학생과 온라인으로 만날 수 있는 해외 외국인학생으로 나뉩니다. 1. 교내 외국인학생동서대학교 International College 소속 외국인 학생이 가장 다수입니다. 베트남, 우즈베키스탄, 인도네시아, 리투아니아, 인도 등 10여개국에서 온 많은 외국인 학생들이 우리 학교에서 유학 중입니다. 모국어가 영어는 아니지만 영어로 전공과정을 이수 중인 영어트랙 학생들인 만큼 영어로 유창하게 소통이 가능합니다. 이 외에 중국의 여러 협정대학 학생들이 다수 있으며, 일본, 태국 등 초청 및 교환학생들도 본 프로그램에서 만날 수 있습니다. 이 경우 중국어, 일본어, 태국어 등 각자 모국어로 소통하게 됩니다.  그리고 동서대학교 외국어교육원에서 한국어 어학연수 중인 외국인학생들이 참여하는 회차도 있습니다.  2. 해외 외국인학생동서대학교는 해외 각지의 세종학당과 협력하고 있습니다. 인도네시아 수라바야 세종학당, 러시아 아스트라한

--- Chunk 25072 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000258
Content:
각지의 세종학당과 협력하고 있습니다. 인도네시아 수라바야 세종학당, 러시아 아스트라한 세종학당, 리투아니아 빌뉴스 세종학당의 학생들과 작년 한 해 꾸준히 Go, Global! 활동을 함께했습니다. 모두 온라인으로 만나며 보통 zoom을 활용합니다. 한국어를 배우고 있는 학생들이라서 한국어로 대부분 소통이 가능한 경우도 있고, 초급 수준인 경우 영어로 소통합니다. 시차가 있어 서로 배려하며 만나는 시간을 조정해야 하는 특징이 있고, 고등학생이나 직장인 학생이 매칭되기도 합니다. 프로그램을 지원할 때 참고해 주세요! ^^

--- Chunk 25073 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000258
Content:
질문

6. 학습포인트(튜터 3점, 튜티 1점)는 일괄 지급되나요?  

답변

- 아닙니다. 튜터링 활동을 성실하게 했는지를 확인한 후 그 결과에 따라 차등 지급합니다.따라서 주어진 활동을 다 하지 못한 경우 학습포인트가 차감될 수 있습니다.

질문

5. 규칙적으로 활동하지 않고 일정 기간에 몰아서 활동을 해도 되나요?  

답변

- 아닙니다. 1주에 1회를 기본으로 합니다. 불가피한 경우 한 주에 2회까지는 가능하지만 그 이상 몰아서 한꺼번에 활동을 하는 것은 인정되지 않습니다.

질문

4. 카카오톡이나 DM을 주고받는 것만으로도 튜터링 활동으로 인정되나요? 

답변

- 아닙니다. 튜터링 활동은 원래 대면 활동이 기본입니다. 불가피한 상황이 아니라면 이 규칙을 지켜주세요.

질문

3. 활동기록표 제출은 언제, 어떻게 해야 하나요?

답변

--- Chunk 25074 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000258
Content:
질문

3. 활동기록표 제출은 언제, 어떻게 해야 하나요?

답변

활동기록표는 활동이 완료 된 후 담당자 이메일를 통해 제출합니다.* 홈페이지에서 파일을 다운로드 한 후, 한 활동을 정리하여 제출하면 됩니다.* 만약 제출 기간이 되었는데 부분적으로 진행된 상황이라면 그때까지 했던 활동만 정리해서 정해진 기간 내에 제출하도록 하세요.

질문

2. 튜티링 활동 1회의 활동 시간 기준은 어떻게 되나요? 

답변

- 학기 중에는 1주에 1시간 활동하는 것을 권장합니다. (기준 : 5주 동안 총 5시간 이상)

질문

1.튜티링 활동은 총 몇 회 해야 하나요? 

답변

- 튜터링 활동은 총 5주에 걸쳐 진행됩니다.그 기간 안에 총 5회를 마무리하면 됩니다.예시) 1주에 1회(1시간)

2
Strategic Design Thinking

Track-based Self-Brand Development

--- Chunk 25142 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000453
Content:
The Department of Game Development offers six types of tracks according to industry standards and needs. Apart from traditional degrees covering a wide range of knowledge and practice areas in game technology, tracks focus on a specialist area of professional application. It is designed for technical experts in the fields of game client, game server, game databases and game AI. The goal of this Track is for students to develop more professionalism as beginning experts in each field, to produce

--- Chunk 25143 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000453
Content:
as beginning experts in each field, to produce the work as a specialist, and to sharpen detailed skills which help connect to the job fields.

--- Chunk 25144 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000453
Content:
2D Oriented Game Programmer
 
This concentration includes the essential courses required for developing 2D games. Through this program, students aim to acquire the ability to program the UI, graphics, animation, effects, sound, mechanics, and gameplay that make up a 2D game client by using game development tools.
 
3D Oriented Game Programmer

--- Chunk 25145 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000453
Content:
3D Oriented Game Programmer
 
This concentration includes the essential courses required for developing 3D games. Through this program, students aim to acquire the ability to program the UI, graphics, animation, effects, sound, mechanics, and gameplay that make up a 3D game client by using game development tools.
 
Game AI Programmer

--- Chunk 25146 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000453
Content:
Game AI Programmer
 
This concentration includes the essential courses required for developing game AI. Through this program, students aim to acquire the programming ability to apply technical methods for building game AI, including artificial neural networks, and to integrate them into games in order to solve given problems.
 
Multiplayer Game Server Programmer

--- Chunk 25147 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000453
Content:
Multiplayer Game Server Programmer
 
This concentration includes the essential courses required for developing game servers. Through this program, students aim to acquire the ability to design game servers and program the technical components that make up a game server by using development tools.
 
Game Tool Programmer

--- Chunk 25148 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000453
Content:
Game Tool Programmer
 
This concentration includes the essential courses required for developing game tools. Through this program, students aim to acquire the ability to design game tools and program the technical components that make up those tools by using development tools.
 
Game Database Programmer

--- Chunk 25149 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000453
Content:
Game Database Programmer
 
This concentration includes the essential courses required for developing game databases. Through this program, students aim to acquire the programming ability to apply technical methods for building game databases and to integrate game servers with games in order to solve given problems.
 
Track Requirements

Micro Degree
 Directing

Producing

Cinematography

VFX & Editing

Directing Track

Micro Degree Overview: The purpose of the MD program is to cultivate the ability to lead the overall direction and theme of a film consistently and to enable actors and staff in their respective fields to perform actual film production. The ultimate goal of the program is to become a director or screenwriter.

--- Chunk 25202 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000449
Content:
Micro Degree Objectives:

--- Chunk 25203 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000449
Content:
Performance Criteria: Analyze the personalities of characters based on the scenario and create appropriate visual expressions for the intended direction, taking into account the abilities and characteristics of the staff in each department.
Knowledge: Knowledge of how to turn ideas into text, how to visualize text, and knowledge of the scope of work for staff in each field.

--- Chunk 25204 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000449
Content:
Skills: The ability to analyze scenarios and characters, present one's own ideas, utilize actors' strengths, and negotiate and persuade.
Attitude: A creative attitude, leadership that embraces swift judgment and staff, and a diligent and patient attitude.

Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000449

--- Chunk 25224 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000185
Content:
OVERVIEW

The International College Game Development Major focuses on training talented individuals who can lead the high demand game industry. Students learn how to produce their own games to prepare for professional employment in the game industry.

This major also runs in association with double major, dual degree, or joint education programs with its international partner universities..

Vision: Produce game development specialists

GOALS
Game Designer
Client programmer
Server programmer

Produce specialists in developing client games with the latest computer graphics, AI, and XR technologies
Produce specialists in developing game servers with database, cloud, and multi-threaded server technologies

--- Chunk 25236 ---

Content:
Joint Degree Program
 MRU2023

'2+2' JOINT DEGREE PROGRAMS
The Game Development Major operates '2+2' Joint Degree Programs with its international partners. It focuses on developing students' creative potential while instilling the technical skills and multilingual proficiencies needed for success.

--- Chunk 25237 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000406
Content:
Joint Degree with Mykolas Romeris University(Lithuania)

--- Chunk 25238 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000406
Content:
The Lithuanian Ministry of Education officially approved a 2+2 Joint Degree Program between Dongseo University (DSU) and Mykolas Romeris University (MRU) in the field of Informatics and Digital Contents. It was launched in September of 2014. Students admitted to the joint degree program take fundamental courses in their major along with Korean language courses at MRU for the first two years of the program. Then they complete the remaining two years of the program at DSU.

--- Chunk 25239 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000406
Content:
Joint Degree with Petra Christian University(Indonesia)
Petra Christian University (PCU) is a major private Christian university in Surabaya, Indonesia, established in 1961. PCU and DSU launched a 2+2 Joint Degree Program in November of 2014. Degrees from both universities will be awarded to students who complete two years of study at PCU and two years of study at DSU in the field of digital contents.

3

Career Tracks
There are two main types of programmers in game development: client developers and server developers. This 2+2 program offers a specialized curriculum designed for both of these roles.

Game Client Developer
In 3rd year, students learn 2D/3D graphics knowledge and various design patterns used in commercial games and start to develop games with a game engine. In 4th year, students are doing graduation projects and prepare stuff for a portfolio.

--- Chunk 25246 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000406
Content:
Game Server Developer

To develop your career as a server programmer, you need to learn subjects like Databases, Game Server Programming and Computer Network in 3rd year. Then students participate as a server programmer for a graduation project.

즐겨찾기

UndergraduateU - START PROGRAM with APUOverview

Overview
 What is a U-START Programme?

U-Start Programme is a special credit-transfer programme between Asia Pacific University(APU) and Dongseo University (DSU) which allows the students of DSU to study their 1st year in APU through credit-transfer courses in APU Foundation Programme in Malaysia before going to Korea to complete the rest of 3 years at DSU. Students need to be registered at DSU.

Who is APU?

--- Chunk 25257 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000605
Content:
The Asia Pacific University of Technology & Innovation (APU) is amongst Malaysia's Premier Private Universities, and is where a unique fusion of technology, innovation and creativity works effectively towards preparing graduates for significant roles in business and society globally. APU has earned an enviable reputation as an award-winning University through its achievements in winning a host of prestigious awards at national and international levels, as well as an excellent track record in

--- Chunk 25258 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000605
Content:
levels, as well as an excellent track record in producing highly employable graduates who are able to immediately contribute to industry upon graduation. Click below to see more on U-START PROGRAMME:

Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000605

Track-based Self-Brand Development

--- Chunk 25269 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000407
Content:
This curriculum is designed to cultivate game programming specialists by guiding students through a structured progression from foundational knowledge to advanced professional practice. In the early stages, students build core competencies through subjects such as Fundamentals of Game Programming, Game Design, Linear Algebra, Programming Method, and Mathematical Foundations for Computer Science. These courses establish the theoretical and technical base required for understanding how games are

--- Chunk 25270 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000407
Content:
base required for understanding how games are designed, implemented, and optimized.As students advance, the curriculum deepens practical application skills through courses including Game Algorithm, Database System, Computer Network, Operating System, 2D Game Programming, 3D Game Programming, Game Tool Programming, and Computer Graphics Programming. These subjects enable students to develop expertise in major areas of game development such as gameplay systems, graphics, tools, networking, and

--- Chunk 25271 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000407
Content:
systems, graphics, tools, networking, and software architecture. Additional studies in Computer Architecture and Artificial Intelligence Programming expand their ability to work with performance-sensitive systems and intelligent game behaviors.In the advanced stage, students apply their accumulated knowledge through project-based and research-oriented courses such as Research Methods, Game Project, Bachelor Thesis 1, Bachelor Thesis 2, Using Engine Game, Portfolio, and Sound Workshop. Through

--- Chunk 25272 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000407
Content:
Game, Portfolio, and Sound Workshop. Through these experiences, students strengthen their ability to design, implement, analyze, and present complete game development outcomes in a professional context.This curriculum is intended to produce highly capable game programming professionals who can pursue diverse career paths, including 2D/3D game client developer, game AI developer, game server developer, design convergence developer, video convergence developer, XR developer, AI convergence

--- Chunk 25273 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000407
Content:
developer, XR developer, AI convergence developer, eLearning developer, and architectural convergence developer. By combining theory, technical practice, interdisciplinary competence, and project experience, the program prepares students to become experts who can respond to the evolving needs of the game industry and related digital content fields.

--- Chunk 25274 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000407
Content:
2D/3D Oriented Game Programmer
This concentration includes the essential courses required for developing 2D/3D games. Through this program, students aim to acquire the ability to program the UI, graphics, animation, effects, sound, mechanics, and gameplay that make up a 3D game client by using game development tools.

Game AI Programmer

--- Chunk 25275 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000407
Content:
Game AI Programmer

This concentration includes the essential courses required for developing game AI. Through this program, students aim to acquire the programming ability to apply technical methods for building game AI, including artificial neural networks, and to integrate them into games in order to solve given problems.

Multiplayer Game Server Programmer

--- Chunk 25276 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000407
Content:
Multiplayer Game Server Programmer

This concentration includes the essential courses required for developing game servers. Through this program, students aim to acquire the ability to design game servers and program the technical components that make up a game server by using development tools.

Game Tool Programmer

--- Chunk 25277 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000407
Content:
Game Tool Programmer

This concentration includes the essential courses required for developing game tools. Through this program, students aim to acquire the ability to design game tools and program the technical components that make up those tools by using development tools.

Game Database Programmer

--- Chunk 25278 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000407
Content:
Game Database Programmer

This concentration includes the essential courses required for developing game databases. Through this program, students aim to acquire the programming ability to apply technical methods for building game databases and to integrate game servers with games in order to solve given problems.

--- Chunk 25293 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000012
Content:
The International College is the only institution at any university in Korea to offer all its program courses in English in the fields of Global Business Administration, Korean Language and Business, Computer Science, Game Development, Animation, Film and Visua Effects and Digital Design. It also offers liberal arts program including Korean language courses.

--- Chunk 25294 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000012
Content:
The International College always endeavors to offer the most advanced curricula in current leading academic fields and also recruits the best Korean and international faculty members to prepare its international students for entering today's competitive global workforce.

--- Chunk 25295 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000012
Content:
The International College also takes great pride in engaging leadership and character development through a variety of non-academic programs. Through these customized programs, our international students are trained to grow, develop, and challenge themselves. Also, they enrich socialization with local students at DSU.
The International College is always there to guide and direct you to your ultimate educational and career goals.

 Undergraduate Programs

--- Chunk 25478 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000011
Content:
Overview
 

 Undergraduate Programs

International College offers all the courses in English in the fields of Korean Language and Business, Global Business Administration, Computer Science, Game Development, Animation, Film and Visual Effects, and Digital Design.  It also collaborates with Minseok College of Liberal Education and offers liberal arts courses including Korean language and culture courses that are conducted in English.  Korean language are taught in English, Japanese, or Chinese.

--- Chunk 25479 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000011
Content:
Graduate Programs

--- Chunk 25480 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000011
Content:
International College manages graduate programs in the fields of Business Administration, Visual Contents (Animation, Film, VFX), and Korean Language Education as a Foreign Language:
- Business Administration offers M.A and Ph.D programs- Visual Contents (Animation, Film, VFX Tracks) offers MA, MFA, and Ph.D programs. Visual Contents consistes of Animation, Film, and VFX tracks

--- Chunk 25481 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000011
Content:
- Korean Language Education as a Foreign Language offers only a Master's program. This program trains Korean languages teachers and students get official license from Korean Ministy of Eduction.

--- Chunk 25482 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000011
Content:
The dedicated faculty and staff of International College help international students in many ways, such as in adjusting comfortably to life on campus, excelling academically, setting definite goals and planning to achieve them. International College also serves as the central coordinator and promoter of diverse extracurricular activities that enrich international students’ socialization with Korean students at Dongseo University.

--- Chunk 25483 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000011
Content:
In addition to degree programs, International College offers a credit program that enables students to earn transferable academic credits by taking courses taught in International College, plus intensive Korean or English language courses.

Why Choose international College at Dongseo University?

Multinational
Both professors and students come from many nations. Office staff uses the language of Korean, English, Chinese and Japanese.

--- Chunk 25484 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000011
Content:
Professional and friendly college for international and Korean students
International College’s kind and highly capable staff help international students adjust to campus life in Korea and succeed in their studies.

Advisory system
International College assigns each student a dedicated academic advisor who is experienced at working with international students.

--- Chunk 25485 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000011
Content:
Hands-on field-study and internship programs
International College offers lots of extracurricular programs and chances for students to develop hands-on experience in high-tech classrooms along with studios, hyper-connected research labs, research centers, and major-related companies.

Business start-up program
International College provides start-up courses and support programs for international students wishing to set up a small business or become self-employed.

--- Chunk 25486 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000011
Content:
Self-designed specialization
International College’s faculty help students select their own specialized academic path by choosing among a wide range of elective courses matching their personal and professional goals.

Project-based learning
International College cultivates essential skills required for the Fourth Industrial Revolution through a unique project-based learning approach.

--- Chunk 25487 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000011
Content:
Liberal education program: courses on Korean language, culture, and society
International College offers courses on Korean language, culture and society for international students to gain the proficiency and understanding needed for major-related jobs in Korea.

UndergraduateGame DevelopmentGraduation Requirement

Graduation Requirement

--- Chunk 25538 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
Graduation Regulation: Game Development Department
1. Background and purpose.
1-1. Establish graduation rules and suggest the necessary standards for application. 
 
1-2. With the aim to nurture talent who lead creative content development, it supports individuals' unique capabilities to be maximized.
 
2. Major contents.

--- Chunk 25539 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
2. Major contents.
2-1 Based on the contents applied the distinctiveness of the educational method in which each major and industry-academia are fused on the graduation rules, detailed regulations shall be specified and implemented by dividing it into three areas: industry-academia, research, and others. (Refer to: Attachment 1: Specification table of the graduation work.)

--- Chunk 25540 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
2-2. It is based on the essential points of content to be evaluated for final graduation considering the purpose of learning, including major, performance, industry-academia cooperation, and employment, through continuous preparation of the student's portfolio with each unique character and production of works related to the function of more than one area, the prospective graduate derives the results of a distinctive self-brand and is evaluated for final graduation.

--- Chunk 25541 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
① Graduation Assessment refers to two stages of review; the first and final assessment.
  ② The first assessment is a preliminary evaluation intended to prepare for the final assessment (main examination).
  ③ The final assessment (main examination) means the final graduation assessment.
 
2-3. Formation of the Graduation Assessment Committee
  ① ‘Graduation Assessment Committee’ is formed to promote graduation assessment.

--- Chunk 25542 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
② Graduation Assessment Committee Chairman: With the approval of the dean of the International College (IC), one of the graduation assessment committee members is appointed as the chairman of the graduation assessment committee.

--- Chunk 25543 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
③ Graduation Assessment Committee Member: The chairperson of the graduation assessment committee shall appoint the professors and industry experts in the relevant major. For the first assessment, three graduation assessment committee members will be selected from inside the school. For the final assessment (main examination), four or more members of the graduation assessment committee (including one external expert for the major) will be selected.

--- Chunk 25544 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
④ Prospective graduate representative: One prospective graduate representative for the major is recommended and elected and assists with the graduation assessment work (contact, preparation, progress, etc.).
  ⑤ Administrative Officer: The chairperson of the Graduation Assessment Committee appoints an administrative officer necessary for the graduation class.
 
2-4. The duties of the graduation assessment committee and the chairman of the graduation assessment committee

--- Chunk 25545 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
① The chairperson of the graduation assessment committee plans and promotes the schedules and contents necessary for assessment, such as first and final assessment.
  ② The Graduation assessment Committee analyzes the results of the first and final assessment, and the graduation works of prospective graduates. 
 
3. Preparatory procedures for graduation application
3-1. Details of the preliminary review of the qualification for applying for graduation work

--- Chunk 25546 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
① Graduation candidates must receive an evaluation of their portfolio and graduation works.
  ② Portfolio: The committee will judge whether the portfolio is suitable for the corresponding field of study.
  ③ Graduation work

--- Chunk 25547 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
Proposal : summary of graduation project or game design, etc., submitted in paper, and presented.
 Final result : Final Graduation Work, Presentation file for final Graduation Work, Final Demo Video and Executable file.

--- Chunk 25548 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
3-2. Exceptions
  ① Students who are unable to participate in the production of graduation works due to reasons(Natural disasters, diseases, war, etc.) recognized by the graduation assessment committee may qualify for graduation after satisfying the conditions of the works and thesis set by the committee.

--- Chunk 25549 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
② In the event of exceptional circumstances (public contest, thesis, etc.) that are not specified in this document, they may be eligible for graduation through deliberation by the Graduation assessment Committee.
 
4. Method and contents of application for graduation assessment
4-1. Prospective graduates must apply for graduation assessment at least one semester prior to the scheduled date of graduation in accordance with the provisions specified below.

--- Chunk 25550 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
① Prepared prospective graduates shall apply for and receive first and final evaluations according to the specified contents below.
  ② The application for graduation review will be completed by submitting the materials required by the graduation assessment committee to the International College.
 
4-2. Submissions and review stage
  ① First assessment

--- Chunk 25551 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
Application : Study Plan of Graduation Work : PDF
 Portfolio : Resume, Portfolio File, Demo Video : PDF and Video
 Graduation Work 

      - Proposal : The Proposal of Graduation Work : PDF
      -- ICT Project: Draft thesis, Graduation Work Presentation File, Exe File and Demo Video.
      -- Game Project : Draft Game Design Document, Graduation Work Presentation File, Exe File and Demo Video.
 
  ② Final assessment

--- Chunk 25552 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
Application : Study Plan of Graduation Work
 Portfolio : Resume, Portfolio File, and Demo Video
 Graduation Work

--- Chunk 25553 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
- Proposal: The Proposal of Graduation Work
      - Final Output
      -- ICT Project: Thesis, Graduation Work Presentation File, Exe File and Demo Video 
      -- Game Project : Game Design Document, Graduation Work Presentation File, Exe File and Demo Video
 
5. Criteria for graduation assessment

--- Chunk 25554 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
5. Criteria for graduation assessment 
5-1. Prospective graduates are evaluated through 2 regular evaluations (First and Final) which consist of the portfolio and graduation work assessment. (Refer to Attachment 2: Evaluation criteria table (weight application for each evaluation area)
  ① First assessment is the review of the development stage for the final evaluation, and does not affect the final assessment.

--- Chunk 25555 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
② If the total score of the portfolio and graduation work Assessment is less than 70 points in the final assessment, the elimination will be confirmed, and the regular examination process must be carried out again.
  ③ In addition, even if the total score of the qualitative and quantitative evaluations exceeds 70% in the final assessment, the evaluation will not be passed if the score in either the individual evaluation area or the graduation project evaluation area is less than 40%.

--- Chunk 25556 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
If there is no request for conditional amendment by the ‘Graduation Assessment Committee,’ a retrial is not conducted.
 If there is a request for a conditional retrial by the ‘Graduation Assessment Committee,’ the conditions must be satisfied within the prescribed procedure and period.

--- Chunk 25557 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
5-2. Announcement of the results of the graduation Assessment
  ① The final results of the graduation Assessment committee are not open to the public and the chairman of the graduation Assessment committee will notify the International College. 
  ② International College provides administrative notices to the students according to the set academic schedule.
 
6. Regulations on ownership of graduation works and on-campus works, and other matters

--- Chunk 25558 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
6-1. The copyright of the graduation work content belongs to the student, and the department holds the neighboring rights.
 
6-2. In the case of video among graduation works, Dongseo University Lead Film and Symbol Logo must be inserted.
 
6-3. Students’ works may be freely used by the university for promotional purposes, as long as it is not for commercial use. If the university intends to use the works for commercial purposes, it must follow appropriate legal procedures with the students.

--- Chunk 25563 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
Industry-academia cooperation Project
The industry-academia project refers to a formalization process within the undergraduate department or a project through industry-academia cooperation. Industry-academia projects focus on what is as consistent with the undergraduate structure as possible, and should also be clear about the benefits and use of final results for students who participated in the project.
Brand Project

--- Chunk 25564 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000195
Content:
Brand Project
The brand project aims to enhance the status of the major as a special purpose project. Its purpose, such as winning an international contest or commercialization through the next branding, should be accurate. The brand project begins with the suggestion of a professor or student, and after the minimum planning stage is carried out, accurate goals must be established and announced to the students.

한국어

--- Chunk 25592 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000138
Content:
Overview
 English

한국어

Korean Language & BusinessA specialized program for international students, cultivating global talent equipped with Korean language communication skills and business expertise. We develop the next generation of leaders who will drive Asian business with a deep understanding of Korean culture and management knowledge.

--- Chunk 25593 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000138
Content:
About Korean Language & BusinessAs Korea's global influence continues to expand, interest in the Korean language and culture is growing worldwide. The KLB (Korean Language & Business) department is a specialized program designed for international students to intensively study Korean language, Korean culture, and business.Our department focuses on three core competencies: Korean language communication as a foreign language, Korean cultural content literacy, and business practical skills. We

--- Chunk 25594 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000138
Content:
literacy, and business practical skills. We offer two tracks—Korean Track and English Track—tailored to students' Korean proficiency levels. Upon graduation, students will be equipped with the competitive edge needed to thrive in Korean companies or Korean enterprises expanding into the Asian market.

--- Chunk 25595 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000138
Content:
Curriculum by Track
Korean TrackIn the 1st and 2nd years, students build global competencies through intensive Korean and English courses. In the 3rd and 4th years, they strengthen practical skills through a business-centered curriculum.

--- Chunk 25596 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000138
Content:
English TrackIn the 1st year, students establish their language foundation through intensive Korean courses within the liberal arts education program. From the 2nd to 4th years, they strengthen practical skills through a curriculum focused on Korean language and business. Korean-related courses are conducted in Korean, while business-related courses are taught in English, allowing students to develop expertise in a bilingual environment.

--- Chunk 25597 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000138
Content:
Graduation Requirements
To graduate, students must complete at least 120 credits (including a minimum of 60 major credits, 30 general education credits (including 12 required credits), and 30 elective credits), pass the comprehensive graduation exam, and obtain at least Level 4 on the Test of Proficiency in Korean (TOPIK).

Competency
Competency

Get to know RISERISE Project Overview

RISE Project Overview

--- Chunk 25605 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000624
Content:
RISE Project Overview
 

Dongseo University’s International College is participating in the 2025 Busan RISE (Regional Innovation System for Higher Education) project. This initiative aims to strengthen cooperation between local universities and the region by cultivating globally competitive talents with digital transformation (DX) capabilities.

 Key Objectives

--- Chunk 25606 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000624
Content:
Key Objectives

Build a region-led innovation ecosystem
Attract international students and foster local DX talents
Promote co-growth between the university and the Busan community

 Key Strategies

--- Chunk 25607 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000624
Content:
Industry-Aligned Education: Operate field-based programs like capstone design and internships tailored to industry needs
Support for International Students: Provide mentoring, career coaching, Korean language and culture education, and participation in global expos and job fairs
Startup Support: Offer customized support for one-person creator startups, lifestyle startups, and tech startups through the EASY Startup Program

--- Chunk 25608 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000624
Content:
Global Branding: Promote international cooperation through bootcamps, global internships, journal publications, and student competitions
Global R&D Hub: Establish a global research consortium with international universities and companies to co-develop solutions and joint publications

--- Chunk 25609 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000624
Content:
Expected Outcomes

Nurture practice-ready talent with global and local insight
Strengthen Busan’s regional competitiveness through university-industry cooperation
Increase international student engagement and retention

--- Chunk 25697 ---

Content:
Welcome to Dongseo University, a premier institution at the forefront of the Film and Visual Effects industry in Korea. In our Film and Visual Effects major at the International College, we are dedicated to cultivating the next generation of visionary artists and technical experts. Our curriculum bridges theoretical foundations with practical expertise, preparing students to become influential creators in a sector that shapes our cultural and media landscapes.

--- Chunk 25698 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000047
Content:
At the heart of our department, Film and Visual Effects are more than subjects—they are gateways to a thriving industry encompassing movies, television, music videos, and advertising. We pride ourselves on producing versatile professionals ready to lead as directors, producers, cinematographers, editors, VFX artists and writers.

--- Chunk 25699 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000047
Content:
Our state-of-the-art facilities are more than just classrooms; they are your canvas and laboratory. Here, you will gain hands-on experience with the finest tools and environments the industry has to offer, enabling you to craft compelling, innovative visual stories.
 
Join us at Dongseo University and start forging your path in this exciting and ever-evolving field. I look forward to welcoming you to our community and supporting you as you explore and realize your creative potential.

				(한국어 과정) 2025 TOPIK 특강(1차) 안내/2025 TOPIK Prep Session(1st)			

Read 181

관리자 
2025-08-29 15:59

--- Chunk 25707 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000625&mode=view&idx=366
Content:
2025년도 한국어 TOPIK 시험 대비를 위한 TOPIK 특강이 진행됩니다.이번 특강은 TOPIK 10월 18일, 11월 16일에 실시하는 공인 TOPIK 시험 직전 대비반으로학생 여러분의 시험 등급 향상에 큰 도움이 될 것입니다.10월, 11월에 있을 시험 일정에 맞춰 2회 진행될 계획입니다.10월(1차)에 수강하지 못하는 학생들은 11월(2차) 강의를 꼭! 신청해주세요.학생 여러분들의 많은 관심과 참여 바랍니다.프로그램명: 2025 TOPIK 특강(1차)프로그램 기간: 10월 셋째주(13~17 중)일정: 주중 2시간 특강 2일(총 4시간) (정확한 시간은 미정)강의는 대면 강의(오프라인 강의)로 진행됩니다. 온라인 강의가 아닙니다.프로그램 신청은 추후 안내될 예정입니다.게시판을 잘 확인해 주세요.특강과 관련하여 문의가 있다면 아래의 연락처로 문의주시길 바랍니다.이메일: dsu.rise.global@gmail.com문의처: 뉴밀레니엄관 8층 라이즈사업단 유준욱The 2025

UndergraduateComputer ScienceGraduation Requirement

Graduation Requirement

--- Chunk 25862 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654
Content:
Graduation Requirement
 

Graduation Requirement
Everything you need to know to successfully complete your Graduation Project or Research Thesis and meet all requirements for graduation from the Computer Science program.

Requirement Type
Project or Thesis
Graduation Project or Research Thesis — choose one

Max Team Size
3
Individual or team project — up to 3 students per team

Minimum Pass Grade
Grade C
Grade C (70–79 pts) or above — all judges must agree

--- Chunk 25863 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654
Content:
English Requirement
At Admission
Score submitted on entry remains valid throughout enrollment

1
Definition

Graduation Project
Build and submit a working system — software, hardware, or a combination of both — and document it as a written thesis.
Examples
Web / mobile application  ·  AI-based system  ·  IoT device  ·  Cloud service  ·  Game  ·  Embedded system

--- Chunk 25864 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654
Content:
Research Thesis
Investigate an existing topic in computer science, conduct your research, and write up your findings as a formal academic thesis.
Examples
AI / ML algorithm study  ·  Security analysis  ·  Performance comparison  ·  Software architecture review

2
How It Works — Process & Timeline

--- Chunk 25865 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654
Content:
2
How It Works — Process & Timeline

Work Individually or Form a Team
You may work individually or form a team of up to 3 students. Submit your project or thesis proposal by the announced deadline, under your advisory professor's guidance.

Develop the Project / Conduct Research
Work on your project or research throughout the semester with ongoing supervision from your advisory professor.

--- Chunk 25866 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654
Content:
Interim Presentation
Present your progress to the judging panel. Incorporate the judges' feedback before the final submission.

Final Presentation and Submission
Submit your completed thesis and present it to the judging committee for final evaluation.

Result
Pass (Grade C or above from all judges) and you are cleared for graduation. Fail and you may re-present during a separately announced re-evaluation period.

3
Evaluation Criteria

--- Chunk 25867 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654
Content:
3
Evaluation Criteria

Judging Committee
2+ Professors
Two or more faculty members serve as judges. The advisory professor may also be included.

Passing Grade
Grade C
All judges must individually award Grade C (70–79 pts) or above. A single judge below C means a fail.

Criteria Set By
Curriculum Committee
Evaluation criteria are set by the major curriculum committee each semester.

--- Chunk 25868 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654
Content:
Important: Failing the re-evaluation, or not submitting a thesis without a valid reason, results in exclusion from graduation for that semester.
      

4
Graduation Comprehensive Examination & Exemptions

Graduation Comprehensive Examination (D.U.S.R. Article 34)

All students must pass the Graduation Comprehensive Examination (Major courses). The exemptions below apply to most CS students:

Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000654

Major Exam Exemption
Pass your Graduation Project or Research Thesis evaluation and you are automatically exempt from the Major examination. (D.U.S.R. Article 69, Clause 3)

English Requirement — International Students (English Track)
No separate English exam is required. Submit a qualifying score at the time of admission and it remains valid for your entire enrollment.

UndergraduateU - START PROGRAM with APUProgram

Program
 

U-Start Programme | Asia Pacific University (APU)

Intakes: March / September

ENTRY REQUIREMENTS

5 Credits in at least 5 subjects at SPM level with a minimum of a pass in Bahasa Malaysia and Sejarah (History)

5 Credits (Grade C & above) in at least 5 subjects at IGCSE/ O-Levels

ENGLISH REQUIREMENTS

MALAYSIAN & INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS

Min. IELTS 5.5.

--- Chunk 25881 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000604
Content:
Min. IELTS 5.5.

* Credit in Mathematics is required for Computing & Technology route 

U-Start Programme is a special credit-transfer programme between Asia Pacific University (APU) and Dongseo University (DSU) which allows the students of DSU to study their 1st year in APU through credit-transfer courses in APU Foundation Programme in Malaysia before going to Korea to complete the rest of 3 years at DSU. Students need to be registered at DSU. All fees are payable to DSU in Korea for Year 1.

--- Chunk 25882 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000604
Content:
Year 1 in Malaysia
3 Years in Korea

Credit-transfer courses in APU Foundation Programme
DSU Bachelor's Degree Programmes

Business
Computer Science, Game Development
Digital Design, Animation, Film & Visual Effects

Global Business Administration
Korean Language and Business*
Game Development
Computer Science
Film and Visual Effects
Animation
Digital Design

* TOPIK 3 Required

WHY SHOULD I CHOOSE U-START PROGRAMME

--- Chunk 25883 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000604
Content:
WHY SHOULD I CHOOSE U-START PROGRAMME  

Global Learning & Cultural Adaptability
Immerse yourself in multicultural experiences at APU during your Foundation programme, fostering a global perspective and cultural adaptability for a connected world.

Seamless Credit Transfer to DSU
Experience a hassle-free transition from APU to DSU through the U-Start Programme. Your APU credits seamlessly transfer to DSU, ensuring a smooth academic progression to Year 2 of Bachelors Degree in DSU Korea.

--- Chunk 25884 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000604
Content:
Preparation for Korea
The U-Start Programme serves as a strategic preparation for your transition to DSU in Korea. Your initial year at APU prepares you academically, exposes you to diverse student dynamics, and instills confidence in navigating an internation educational environment, ensuring a smoother integration into DSU.

ENRICHING EXPERIENCES - MORE THAN JUST A FOUNDATION  
The credit-transfer courses in APU Foundation Programme lays the pathway towards professional tertiary education. It is a vital transformation point for students; soft skills, general knowledge and preparatory subject fundamentals acquired at the Foundation lead to excellence in a student’s education performance, as well as career- readiness as they move on as global professionals eventually.This is achieved through 4 key areas:

--- Chunk 25890 ---

DSU is one of the leading universities in Busan, South Korea. The Dongseo Educational Foundation has given rise to three different institutions of higher education: Kyungnam College of Information and Technology (1965), Dongseo University (1992), and Busan Digital University (2002). Together these three institutions – KIT, DSU and BDU– educate around 20,000 students annually and employ over 1,000 professors.

--- Chunk 25924 ---

Content:
Microdegree (Career Path)
 

Micro Degree (MD)
✦ Career Path Program
A Micro Degree (MD) is your Career Path — specialized credentials earned alongside your bachelor's degree. Each track focuses intensely on a single, professionally applicable subject to sharpen your expertise and strengthen your career profile.

4 Specialized Tracks
Industry-Aligned Curriculum
Extracurricular Recognition
Career-Ready Skills

--- Chunk 25925 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000653
Content:
What Is a Micro Degree?
Unlike a traditional degree that covers a broad range of topics, a Micro Degree (MD) is an intensive, focused program in a single, professionally applicable subject. By completing specific required courses and extracurricular activities, students earn a recognized credential that demonstrates specialized expertise to future employers.

Traditional Degree
Broad knowledge across a wide field of study

Micro Degree
Deep, industry-focused expertise in one specialty

--- Chunk 25926 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000653
Content:
Outcome
Recognized credential + specialized skills

Why Micro Degree?

01
Stand Out to Employers
A recognized credential that shows specialized expertise beyond your general degree — exactly what industry employers are looking for.

02
Focus Your Career Path
Choose the track that matches your career goals — Cloud, Full-Stack, IoT, or AI — and build targeted, job-ready expertise.

--- Chunk 25927 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000653
Content:
03
Build a Stronger Portfolio
Through required courses and extracurricular activities, you develop practical projects and real-world experience to showcase to future employers.

04
Complete Alongside Your Degree
No extra time needed. MD courses overlap with your regular curriculum, so you earn a specialized credential without extending your graduation timeline.

Academic Roadmap
 

Academic Roadmap
Plan your academic journey with our comprehensive roadmap, tailored to your chosen track and designed to guide you from freshman year to graduation.

Graduation Requirements

Total Credits
120 credits

Liberal Education
30 credits

Fall Semester Entry Spring Semester Entry

Course Sequence Guide
The following roadmap shows the recommended course sequence for students. Use this as a guide to plan your 4-year academic journey.

Before You Start — Please Read

This roadmap is a recommended guideline, not a strict requirement.
Select the roadmap that matches your admission semester.
Course availability may vary by semester.
Consult your academic advisor.

--- Chunk 26008 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000644
Content:
Students affiliated with the International College are required to complete a total of 30 credits of elective liberal arts courses before graduation. In addition, it is a basic principle of the International College that these elective liberal arts courses be taken with a focus on Korean language, Korean culture, and Korean society.The International College aims to cultivate globally competent professionals grounded in a deep understanding of Korea through education centered on the Korean

--- Chunk 26009 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000644
Content:
of Korea through education centered on the Korean language, Korean culture, and Korean society. Accordingly, completing elective liberal arts courses in Korean is a fundamental principle for realizing this educational philosophy.This approach provides an essential foundation not only for students’ academic adaptation in Korea but also for their long-term settlement within the local community. Furthermore, Korean companies and institutions place strong emphasis on practical Korean language

--- Chunk 26010 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000644
Content:
strong emphasis on practical Korean language proficiency in professional settings.Taking liberal arts courses focused on the Korean language, Korean culture, and Korean society helps students systematically develop the specialized vocabulary, document comprehension, and written communication skills required in real working environments.Please complete your courses in accordance with the guidelines below, and be sure to follow the guidance of your academic advisor.

Course Sequence Guide
The following roadmap shows the recommended course sequence for students. Use this as a guide to plan your 4-year academic journey.

Before You Start — Please Read

This roadmap is a recommended guideline, not a strict requirement.
Select the roadmap that matches your admission semester.
Course availability may vary by semester.
Consult your academic advisor.

Micro Degree(Career Path)

--- Chunk 26063 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000658
Content:
Micro Degree(Career Path)
 

Micro Degree (MD)
✦ Career Path Program
A Micro Degree (MD) is your Career Path — specialized credentials earned alongside your bachelor's degree. Each track focuses intensely on a single, professionally applicable subject to sharpen your expertise and strengthen your career profile.

3 Specialized Tracks
Industry-Aligned Curriculum
Extracurricular Recognition
Career-Ready Skills

--- Chunk 26064 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000658
Content:
What Is a Micro Degree?
Unlike a traditional degree that covers a broad range of topics, a Micro Degree (MD) is an intensive, focused program in a single, professionally applicable subject. By completing specific required courses and extracurricular activities, students earn a recognized credential that demonstrates specialized expertise to future employers.

Traditional Degree
Broad knowledge across a wide field of study

Micro Degree
Deep, industry-focused expertise in one specialty

--- Chunk 26065 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000658
Content:
Outcome
Recognized credential + specialized skills

Why Micro Degree?

01
Stand Out to Employers
A recognized credential that demonstrates specialized knowledge in business, marketing, data analysis, and strategic thinking — exactly the kind of practical expertise employers value in today’s competitive job market.

--- Chunk 26066 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000658
Content:
02
Focus Your Career Path
Choose the track that best matches your career goals — such as marketing, AI and data-driven business, global management, or service innovation — and develop targeted, job-ready competencies.

03
Build a Stronger Portfolio
Through required courses and extracurricular activities, students gain practical experience and create a strong portfolio that showcases their business skills and readiness for real-world challenges.

--- Chunk 26067 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000658
Content:
04
Complete Alongside Your Degree
No extra time needed. Micro Degree courses are integrated into your regular curriculum, allowing you to earn a specialized credential in business administration without extending your graduation timeline.

Choose Your Micro Degree Track

Marketing Strategy and Planning is a core business capability that enables companies to deliver superior value and services to customers while differentiating themselves from competitors by emphasizing their unique advantages. The goal of the Marketing Strategy and Planning Microdegree is to develop students into strategic marketers who can analyze contemporary marketing issues from a strategic perspective. Students will learn how to design, develop, and implement effective marketing strategies

■ 지원대상 Eligibility - 창업에 관심 있는 동서대학교 학부생 또는 대학원생을 대표학생으로 하는 창업동아리   Startup clubs led by a representative student (undergraduate or graduate) of Dongseo University who has an interest in entrepreneurship - 동서대학교에 재학 중인 학생을 대상으로 지원   Applicants must be currently enrolled students at Dongseo University.  ※ RISE 창업스쿨 창업동아리와 교내 타 창업동아리 프로그램 간 중복 아이템 신청 불가     Duplicate application of the same startup item with other on-campus startup club programs is not allowed.  ■ 창업동아리 구성 요건 Startup Club

UndergraduateInterdisciplinary MajorsDigital MarketingOverview

Overview

--- Chunk 26139 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000633
Content:
Create, Connect, and Lead Your Future 
The Digital Marketing (DM) program at the International College of Dongseo University is where creativity meets strategy, and ideas become real-world impact.
Operating under the umbrella of Digital Design (DD) and officially managed by the DD program, DM offers a unique interdisciplinary pathway that combines Global Business Administration (GBA) and Digital Design (DD).

--- Chunk 26140 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000633
Content:
Students begin their journey by applying to the Digital Design program, and after enrollment, they may transition into the Digital Marketing major—unlocking opportunities to explore both business insight and creative design in a single, integrated program.
As a DM student, you are part of the DD program, and your tuition follows the DD structure—ensuring a consistent academic experience within a strong design-based foundation.

--- Chunk 26141 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000633
Content:
Why Digital Marketing at DSU? 
Today’s world needs more than marketers. It needs creative thinkers, data interpreters, and digital storytellers—people who can understand audiences and turn insight into meaningful experiences.
This program is designed for students who want to:

- Think creatively and strategically at the same time
- Work at the intersection of data, design, and technology
- Build brands that connect with people across cultures and platforms

--- Chunk 26142 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000633
Content:
What You Will Become  At DSU, you will grow into a next-generation digital professional who can:

- Transform data into powerful marketing strategies
- Design content that captures attention and builds brand identity
- Create seamless digital experiences that users love
- Apply cutting-edge technologies to real-world challenges

You won’t just learn marketing. You will learn how to shape digital experiences that matter.

Your Future, Your Possibilities

--- Chunk 26143 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000633
Content:
Your Future, Your Possibilities 

Graduates of the DM program are prepared to take on roles such as:

- Digital Marketing Strategist
- Brand & Content Designer
- UX/UI & Digital Experience Designer

—from global companies and creative agencies to startups and emerging industries.

What Makes This Program Different?

--- Chunk 26144 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000633
Content:
1. Data + Creativity You will learn how to combine analytics with creative thinking to make smarter decisions.
2. Real-World Skills From Python and data tools to Adobe and Figma, you will build practical, industry-ready capabilities.
3. Design-Driven Thinking Unlike traditional marketing programs, this program emphasizes visual communication and user experience.
4. Global Perspective Work across cultures, collaborate internationally, and prepare for a global career.

--- Chunk 26145 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000633
Content:
Your Journey Starts Here
At DSU Digital Marketing, you don’t just study a major—you build a future.
You will learn how to create, connect, and lead in the global digital world.

Program Vision

To cultivate innovative digital-marketing leaders who integrate analytical thinking, creative design, and emerging technology to create, communicate, and sustain brand value in the digital era.

 

Educational Goals

--- Chunk 26146 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000633
Content:
Educational Goals

1.Develop data-driven marketing strategy skills – Analyze consumer behavior and market trends to design effective digital strategies.
2.Strengthen brand-centered content creation – Visualize brand identity and storytelling through multimedia formats such as video, motion graphics, and interactive media.
3.Integrate design and user experience – Use UX/UI, web, and AR/VR design to deliver engaging, user-focused communication.

--- Chunk 26147 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000633
Content:
4.Build technology-based professional skills – Apply tools such as Python, Adobe Suite, and immersive-media technologies to real-world marketing practice.

Graduate Profile
“A cross-disciplinary professional who connects strategy, content, and user experience to shape digital brand value.”

Graduates become:

Data-Driven Marketing Strategists
Brand-Focused Content Designers

Digital Experience (UX/UI) Designers    — ready to lead in agencies, startups, and creative industries worldwide.

--- Chunk 26148 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000633
Content:
Core Competencies
What You Will Learn
The Digital Marketing major develops four integrated competencies that bridge creativity and analytics:
1.Digital Analytics–Based Marketing Strategy
Collect and interpret web traffic, consumer data, and social-media metrics to craft measurable marketing strategies.

Skills: Python and Tableau for data visualization, customer segmentation, digital-funnel design, KPI management (ROAS, conversion rate).

2.Brand Planning & Content Creation

--- Chunk 26149 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000633
Content:
2.Brand Planning & Content Creation

Plan brand stories and express them visually and verbally across multiple platforms.

Skills: Brand identity development, digital campaign design, storytelling, and cross-media content production using Adobe and Figma.

3.Visual Communication

Deliver compelling visual messages that connect emotionally with audiences.

Skills: Typography, color systems, layout, motion graphics, AR filters, and interactive media design.

4.User Experience & Interface Design

--- Chunk 26150 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000633
Content:
4.User Experience & Interface Design

Design intuitive digital experiences based on user research and interaction analysis.

Skills: UX research, information architecture, prototype development (Figma, Adobe XD), and spatial UX for metaverse or AR/VR environments.

--- Chunk 26151 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000633
Content:
How These Competencies Connect
Each competency reinforces the others—data insights shape creative design, visual storytelling enhances user experience, and technology enables strategic decisions. Together they form a holistic skill set for success in digital communication and marketing innovation.

Graduation Requirement

--- Chunk 26293 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000660
Content:
Graduation Requirement
 

Graduation Requirement
Everything you need to know to successfully complete your Graduation Project, Portfolio, and meet all requirements for graduation from the Animation program.

Requirement Type
Portfolio & Project
You must complete both a Graduation Project and a Specialized Portfolio.

Minimum Pass Grade
Grade C
Grade C (70–79 pts) or above — all judges must agree

1
Definition

--- Chunk 26294 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000660
Content:
1
Definition

Graduation Project
Students choose one track to demonstrate professional-level output:
Animation Short Film: Create animated shorts for submission to International Festivals.
Industry-University Cooperation: Joint development under industry supervision for commercialization.
Research Thesis: Academic research published in quality journals such as SCI, Scopus, or KCI
Brand Project: A special purpose project designed to raise the status of the major.

--- Chunk 26295 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000660
Content:
Portfolio (Demo Reel)
A compilation of short clips showcasing your expertise in a specific area:
Concept Design: Focuses on life drawing, anatomy, and character turnaround sheets.
3D Modeling: Includes finished pieces with turntables, lighting, and polished renders.
Technical Animation: Pipeline and systems, complex biped/facial rigs, Python/API tools, and motion capture integration.
Animation: Demonstrates body mechanics, acting, and the 12 principles of animation.

--- Chunk 26296 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000660
Content:
Visual Effects: Covers digital compositing, dynamics, and VFX pipeline management.

--- Chunk 26297 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000660
Content:
2
How It Works — Process & Timeline

First Assessment (Preliminary)
A review of the development stage to prepare for the final evaluation. This does not affect the final score.

Final Assessment
The definitive evaluation of your portfolio and project work.

Submission Standards
Materials must meet specific video specs (H.264 codec) and PDF formats or they will not be judged.

Committee Review
Evaluated by at least three committee members, including professors or industry experts.

4
Mandatory Documentation & Rules

University Branding: All video works must include the Dongseo University Symbol Logo.
Portfolio Document Requirements: Must include a Portfolio Study, a Resume, and Job Research.
Festival Entry: Animation Short Film projects must include a Festival certificate of entry.
Copyright: Copyright belongs to the student, while the department holds neighboring rights.

UndergraduateGame DevelopmentStudy Group

Study Group
 

Game Project Lab(GP101)

--- Chunk 26309 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000193
Content:
Study Group
 

Game Project Lab(GP101)

Professor: Jintaek Seo       
- Research Areas : C/C++/C# Programming, Game programming with Unity Engine- Student Leader : n/a

--- Chunk 26310 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000193
Content:
• Purpose
GP101 Lab is a research group dedicated to exploring and advancing the art and science of game development using Unity. Our primary goal is to cultivate student creativity, technical proficiency, and collaborative skills by designing, prototyping, and developing original games. We aim to bridge academic learning with real-world application through hands-on projects, workshops, and industry engagement.

• Research Interests

  - Game Mechanics and System Design

--- Chunk 26311 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000193
Content:
- Game Mechanics and System Design

  - Interactive Storytelling and Narrative Structure

  - Artificial Intelligence in Games

  - Game User Interface (UI) and User Experience (UX)

  - Multiplayer and Networked Game Architecture

  - Mobile and Cross-Platform Game Development

  - Serious Games and Educational Applications

  - Procedural Content Generation

  - Game Engine Optimization and Performance Tuning

  - Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR) Experiences

--- Chunk 26312 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000193
Content:
• Contact: jintaeks@dongseo.ac.kr

Open Source Projects
We are contributing to some open source projects.

https://github.com/gp101

Rendering Engine Principle for Studying

- Rendering is an essential part of a game engine. This open-source project will help you understand the principles of the 3D rendering engine.

2D Physics Engine Principle for Studying
- This open-source project will help you understand the principles of the 2D physics engine.

--- Chunk 26313 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000193
Content:
C++ Game Server Project
- This project involves implementing a powerful game server using C++ and IOCP on the Windows platform.

Content:
Overview
 

International College Computer Science
Empowering the next generation of innovators with cutting-edge knowledge in software development, artificial intelligence, and computational thinking to lead the 21st-century knowledge economy.

--- Chunk 26333 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000637
Content:
About Computer Science
Computer Science is constantly evolving, and it is an exciting time to be part of this dynamic, rapidly growing field. The International College Computer Science major aims to nurture highly qualified professionals equipped with the creative, hands-on skills necessary to lead the knowledge and information industry of the 21st century, including software development, AI, and cloud computing.

--- Chunk 26334 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000637
Content:
Our curriculum provides practice-oriented training that reflects the demands of the IT industry, helping you build specialized knowledge that enhances quality and competitiveness. Through our comprehensive education system, which combines curricular and co-curricular programs, we prepare students for diverse career paths from entry to post-graduation.

--- Chunk 26335 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000637
Content:
Four Core Competencies

1
Creative Convergence
Ability to integrate diverse technologies and think innovatively to solve complex problems through convergent thinking and creative approaches.

2
Software Design
Capability to analyze problems systematically and architect robust system structures and software solutions based on solid theoretical foundations.

--- Chunk 26336 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000637
Content:
3
Software Development
Skills to transform designs into functional code and working systems, implementing solutions that meet real-world requirements and industry standards.

4
Industry Adaptation
Understanding of industry trends, technological changes, and the ability to apply knowledge effectively in real-world professional contexts.

Specialized Educational Tracks

TRACK 01
Software Developer Track
Front-end | Back-end | Full-stack

--- Chunk 26337 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000637

Comprehensive training in software engineering principles and best practices

TRACK 02
AI Application Track
Applied AI | LLM Services | Research Track

--- Chunk 26339 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000637

A specialized track reflecting current industry trends, focusing on practical AI application capabilities rather than research-heavy approaches, with advanced learning extending to LLM expertise.

Understanding fundamental principles and application-focused education in AI models
Development of skills in LLM-based services and system utilization
Pathways to research activities and graduate studies through advanced learning
Practical AI implementation skills for real-world industry applications

Motion Graphics Design

--- Chunk 26387 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000435
Content:
Track Overview

--- Chunk 26388 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000435
Content:
In the Motion Graphics Design track, you’ll explore how movement, timing, and visual storytelling create powerful digital narratives. You’ll develop advanced skills in animation, compositing, and time-based media production using industry-standard creative tools, while experimenting with interactive and real-time visual systems. Through studio projects, you’ll learn how motion graphics shape communication across advertising, digital displays, entertainment media, and immersive environments.

--- Chunk 26389 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000435
Content:
This track prepares students to design dynamic visual experiences that merge creativity with technical precision. Graduates are equipped to work in environments where motion, sound, and interaction redefine how audiences engage with visual content.

--- Chunk 26390 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000435
Content:
Possible Job Titles
Creative & Visual Roles: Motion Designer, Animator, Video Editor, Multimedia Artist, Visual Effects Designer, Broadcast Graphics Designer, Interactive Media Designer.
Technical Roles: Compositing Artist, Real-Time Graphics Designer, Digital Display Content Designer.
Strategic Roles: Visual Content Director, Creative Producer.
Emerging Roles: Immersive Media Designer, Experiential Visual Designer.

--- Chunk 26391 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000435
Content:
Relevant Courses
Motion Graphics Design Advanced Motion Graphics Design Visual Effects Digital Publishing 3D Modeling and Animation Real-Time Media Design

Extracurricular Activities
Internship with media studios or digital production companies. Participation in motion graphics festivals or competitions. Collaborative audiovisual or installation projects.

--- Chunk 26401 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000046
Content:
Overview
 

Film and Visual Effects offers one of the best education systems in Korea. All the courses are delivered in English.

--- Chunk 26402 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000046
Content:
The faculty is comprised of professionals from each specific area including directing, producing, cinematography & lighting, editing, sound, VFX, and theory. The professors who are experts in this area shall concurrently provide lessons on the overall process of film and provide concentrated training by function. Students shall learn about the actual work of the commercial film production through the courses and workshop. Film and Visual Effects Department encourages students to develop their

--- Chunk 26403 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000046
Content:
encourages students to develop their imagination and creativity with the most up-to-date digital tools, and also teaches the practices and theories that emerge from the convergence of new media technologies.

--- Chunk 26404 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN0000046
Content:
Film and Visual Effects Department runs double major, dual degree, or joint education programs with its international partner universities.

GOALS: Produce next generation filmmakers and VFX artists

CORE COURSES

Directing
Producing
Cinematography
Editing
Screenwriting
Sound Design

Digital Filmmaking
Fundamental Figure Drawing
Compositing
Matte Painting
Rotoscoping

CAREER PATHS

VFX artists

Cinematographer

Sound Designer

				(한국어 과정) 2025 TOPIK 특강(1차) 참가자 모집			

Read 398

관리자 
2025-10-02 15:24

--- Chunk 26440 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000625&mode=view&idx=376
Content:
Read 398

관리자 
2025-10-02 15:24

2025년도 한국어 TOPIK 시험 대비를 위한 TOPIK 특강이 진행됩니다.이번 특강은 TOPIK 10월 18일에 실시하는 공인 TOPIK 시험 직전 대비반으로학생 여러분의 시험 등급 향상에 큰 도움이 될 것입니다.프로그램명: 2025 TOPIK 특강(1차)프로그램 기간: 10월 15일(수), 17일(금)일정: 13:00~15:00(2시간) 특강 2일(총 4시간)수강인원: 20명(선착순)강의실: International College 603호신청링크: https://forms.gle/w5ZB9BNjL74CZJNm6강의는 대면 강의(오프라인 강의)로 진행됩니다. 온라인 강의가 아닙니다.응답을 제출한 이메일로 선정 여부를 알려드립니다.이메일을 잘 확인해주세요.특강과 관련하여 문의가 있다면 아래의 연락처로 문의 주시길 바랍니다.이메일: dsu.rise.global@gmail.com문의처: 뉴밀레니엄관 8층 라이즈사업단 유준욱

Dongseo University supervises the Chapel to understand the truth of Christianity to realize the founding ideology “Realization of Christianity spirit” and to enrich our psychological and spiritual life. Student chapel on the contrary to chapel service, is during school hours, not on the weekend, with believers and nonbelievers together to learn the value of Christianity to recognize their own belief and change their personality to develop the leadership for society, country, and the world. Main

Freshman, Sophomore, Junior shall take the chapel class as a mandatory class, the measure of the grade for a freshman, and a sophomore is “P”(pass), for a junior it is 1(credit). The venue is an auditorium in Industry & Academy cooperation hall. The grade will be calculated by attitude and attendance and students shall sit on their own seat to get an attendance. A

Career Tracks

한국어

Career Track

Students in the major can receive the following four Tracks upon completion of the given curriculum. In addition, we recommend that students explore various MDs from other interdisciplinary programs and acquire one or more additional ones.

--- Chunk 26565 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000440
Content:
Korean Communication Career Tracks

--- Chunk 26566 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000440
Content:
- The purpose of this program is to develop proficiency in Korean language communication across all four language skills: speaking, listening, reading, and writing. The program includes courses on Korean culture and business Korean, taking into account various Korean language usage environments and genres such as pronunciation, grammar, rhetoric, and composition. Through this program, students will gain knowledge and skills in Korean language communication to achieve their goals.

--- Chunk 26567 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000440

Certification Lecture (1) TOPIK

--- Chunk 26568 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000440
Content:
Certification Lecture (1) TOPIK

 Korean creative contents Track
- Through various texts, this intensive course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of humanities knowledge about Korean society, including culture, politics, economy, history, and literature. The purpose of this course is to enhance students' capacity for Korean cultural content as local experts, allowing them to assume their roles effectively.

MD Composition

Content:
Academic Forum

 Business literacy Track
- This intensive course aims to enhance efficient communication skills in a business environment and cultivate business literacy. Through this program, students will be able to apply the acquired knowledge of business theories and business Korean language skills to practical situations immediately.

--- Chunk 26572 ---
Source: https://uni.dongseo.ac.kr/ic/index.php?pCode=MN2000440
Content:
Business Manager Track
- A concentrated program that cultivates foreign talents who can proactively adapt to the global business environment. Through this program, in-depth understanding of advanced theoretical knowledge in business majors and specialized education that focuses on specific areas will be provided to enhance business vocational and practical skills, aimed at developing professionals who can navigate the ever-changing landscape of global business.
